第一章 总则 
Chapter 1 General Principles 
1.0 目的 
Purpose 
本计划规定了船岸应急准备、演习和训练程序，制定了船岸应急反应程序和须知，为
船岸应急反应提供指导。 
The plan stipulates the procedures of ship-shore emergency preparation, drill and exercise, as well as the 
emergency response procedure and instructions, and provides guidance for ship-shore emergency 
response.  
2.0 紧急情况的标明 
Mark of Emergency 
本计划中的紧急情况根据《船上操作方案的制定程序》确定，并考虑到航运界最经常
出现的紧急情况、本公司曾经出现过的紧急情况。 
The emergent situatio ns in the plan are determined according to Shipboard Operation Establishment 
Procedures, combining the frequently occurred emergency in marine industry as well as the emergency 
happened to our company. 
3.0 定义 
Definition 
3..1 船舶紧急情况 
Ship's emergency 
船舶紧急情况是指船舶出现的开始对人员或船舶安全构成严重威胁，或对周围环境构
成严重危害的情况。公司规定的紧急情况包括： 
Ship's emergency refers to situations that seriously threaten the crews' or ship's safety, or cause severe 
harm to surrounding environment. Emergency in the company's regulations includes: 
 主机失灵： 船舶推进装置及其动力系统丧失功能或失去控制， 导致船舶推进和操纵能
力的丧失或者受到严重影响， 并且面对或即将面对恶劣天气或复杂水域航行等危及船
舶安全的情况。 
Main Engine Failure: situation under which ship's propulsion machinery and its power system fail and 
get out of control, which causes failure or impact on ship's propulsion and maneuvering ability and is 
facing or will face situations that threatens ship’s safety such as severe weather or complicated 
navigation. 
 操舵系统故障：舵设备的遥控装置失灵， 导致驾驶台对舵设备的控制能力丧失或受到
严重影响，并且面对或即将面对恶劣天气或复杂水域航行等危及船舶安全的情况。 
Steering System Failure: situation under which the remote control of the rudder fails, which leads to 
failure or heavy impact on wheel house’s control over the steering gear, and is facing or will face 
severe weather or complicated navigation.  
 全船断电：船舶主供电系统意外不工作使船舶失电而危及船舶安全的情况。 
Ship Black Out: situation under which the main power supply system accidently fails, which cuts off 
the power supply and threatens the ship’s safety.  
 火警：船舶发生火灾或火灾的征兆，危及船舶安全的情况。 
Fire Alarm: situation under which the ship is on fire or has signs of fire, which threatens the ship’s 
safety. 
 船舶进水：自舷外向机舱或货舱内大量漏水而危及船舶安全的情况。

Flooding of the Ship: situation under which water heavily leaked from shell plating to engine r oom or 
cargo holds, which threatens ship’s safety. 
 碰撞：与其它船舶或海上设施发生意外接触，正造成损害或可能造成损害，危及船舶
安全的情况。 
Collision: situation under which collision with other ships or off -shore units happens, which is causing 
or will cause damage, and threatens the ship’s safety. 
 搁浅：船舶搁置在浅滩上并造成损坏或可能造成损坏，危及船舶安全的情况。 
Grounding: situation under which the ship is grounded at shallow water area, which is causing or will 
cause damage, and threatens the ship’s safety. 
 人员落水： 船员、 旅客或其他人员自本船舶意外落入舷外水中， 危及生命安全的情况。 
Man Overboard: situation under which crew, passenger or others accidently drop into water overboard, 
and threatens life safety. 
 弃船：船舶因为各种原因导致船舶将要失去浮力，或火灾、爆炸等就要危及船员生命
时，船员为求生而被迫放弃船舶的情况。 
Abandon Ship: situation under which the ship is abandoned for crews ’ survival when she is about to 
sink due to various reasons, or the life safety of crews onboard is threatened by fire or explosion. 
 封闭处所人员救助：人员在封闭处所内意外遇险，危及生命而须采取救助的情况。 
Rescue People in Enclosed Places : situation under which people in enclosed places are in danger, 
which requires salvation.   
 船员严重伤病： 船员或旅客在本船因意外受重伤或患严重疾病， 需要紧急救治， 否则
会危及生命或致残的情况。 
Crew’s Serious Injury and Illness: situation under which crews or passengers are accidently injured or 
seriously fall ill, which requires emergency treatment in preventing demise or permanent disability. 
 恶劣天气：船舶遭受强风强浪或涌等袭击对船舶安全构成直接威胁的情况。 
Severe Weather：situation under which the ship encounters heavy wind or wave, which threatens the 
ship’s safety. 
 货物移动： 船上货物发生位置移动， 损害船舶稳性或货物撞击船舶并对船舶构成危险
的情况。 
Cargo Shifting: situation under which the cargo onboard shift, which d amage the stability of the ship, 
or hit the ship and threatens the ship’s safety. 
 船体结构损坏： 船体结构意外损坏， 导致船舶整体或局部强度发生变化， 并可能进一
步导致船舶结构损坏而危及船舶安全的情况。 
Hull Structure Damage: situation under which the ship ’s hull structure is accidently damaged, which  
leads to change of strength of the whole or part of the ship, and may further cause damage to ship’ s 
structure and threatens ship’s safety. 
 救助：船舶、船员或货物处于危险当中，而需要他人援助的情况。 
Salvation: situation under which the ship, crew or cargo is in danger, which requires salvation. 
 保安威胁：可能或者正在发生的针对船舶、船员、旅客、船上货物或物料的任何蓄意
的或可疑的敌对或非法行为。 
Security Threats: any deliberate or suspicious act of hostility, or any illegal act that is happening or 
will happen to the ship, crew, passenger, cargo or material onboard.   
 溢油：涉及本船舶的意外操作性溢油或事故性溢油， 正在或可能造成水域环境污染的
情况。 
Oil Spillage: situation under which the ship’ s oil spillage is causing or will cause environmental 
pollution due to mal-operation or accidents.

3..2 公司应急反应小组：由最高管理层相关人员和安全管理相关部门负责人组成，在船舶
发生紧急情况时能够及时地作出反应，指挥、协调岸基相关人员的行动并为船舶

    Company Emergency Response Team : formed by personnel from top management and safety 
management department, aims to response in time when ship encounters emergency, guide and 
coordinate the shore -based personnel to support the ship. See Chapter 3 for detailed  composition and 
responsibility of the team. 
3..3 持久性紧急情况：不能判明船舶发生的可在短期内结束的紧急情况，或者已经判定紧
急情况仍将持续的情况。 
    Lasting emergency: situation under which the emergency is hard to be diagnosed as short-term 
emergency, or it is recognized to be lasting.   
4.0 范围 
Scope 
本计划适用于公司岸基和所管的船舶。 
The Plan applies to company’s shore-based office and ships. 
5.0  计划介绍 
Plan Introduction 
本计划属于公司安全管理的重要文件之一。 
The plan is one of the most important files of Company’s safety management. 
5.1 标明船上可能发生的紧急情况， 并规定了船上应采取的措施和岸上应提供的支持的程
序。 
It marks the emergency that could happen onboard, and stipulates the procedures of the responding 
measures onboard and support from shore. 
5.2 规定了船岸应急准备、 应急训练和演习的要求， 以使船岸人员充分熟悉紧急情况时应
采取的措施，增强处理紧急情况的能力和信心。 
It specifies the requirements of ship -shore emergency preparations, trainings and drills, familiarizes the 
personnel onboard and on shore with the proper measures taken under emergency, and strengthens the 
ability and confidence to deal with emergency. 
5.3 本计划参照《〈国际安全管理规则〉应用指南》制定。 
The Plan was drafted referring to the ISM Code.  
5.4 本计划为船舶紧急情况船岸联合行动的指导性文件， 但并不妨碍船长从考虑船员、 船
舶和海洋环境的最高利益出发而采取其认为必要的应急行为。 
The Plan is the guiding document for ship- shore joint action taken under ship’s emergency, but shall 
not hamper the Master’s emergency acts that was regarded of paramount interests of crew, ship, and 
marine environment.   
5.5 为了本计划得到有效落实，涉及其任务的有关人员必须充分理解和完全熟悉本计划，
并按照本计划规定的方法实施应急行动的训练和演习。 
To effectively implement the Plan, personnel involved shall make full sense of the Plan, and execute 
emergency exercise and drill according to the procedure demonstrated in the Plan.

2.0  船舶应急准备 
Ship Emergency Preparation 
2.1 船长应保证用于安全和防污染的所有的应急设备处于良好工作状态。 
The master shall ensure that all emergency equipment for safety and anti-pollution is in good working 
condition. 
2.2 且所有的应急设备的操作说明均已妥善张贴。 
And operation instructions for all emergency equipment shall be properly posted. 
2.3 船长负责保证所有船员在开航前均能熟悉船舶环境、 应急设备的布置和操作方法， 及
其本人的应急岗位职责和应急反应程序。 
The master shall be responsible for guaranteeing all crew are familiar with the ship ’s environment, the 
placement and operation of emergency equipment, their respective emergency post responsibilities, and 
emergency response procedures before sailing.  
2.4 针对消防、弃船、溢油和营救落水人员必须制定应变部署，相应的应变部署（包括个
人应变任务卡）必须在开航前完成并下达。 
Emergency deployment for fire fight ing, ship abandonment, oil spillage  and rescue for man overboard 
must be developed, and the corresponding emergency  deployment (including personal task cards) must 
be completed and issued before sailing. 
2.5 船舶应配备所有公司应急反应小组成员和公司主管人员的详细通讯号码， 并张贴于驾
驶台、集控室、通讯设备处所和船员餐厅。 
The ship shall be equipped with the contact details for all members of the company’s Emergency 
Response Team  and company’s management team, and post the contact details in the wheel house, 
central control room, communication equipment premises, and the crew canteen. 
3.0  应急训练和演习 
Emergency Exercise and Drills 
应急演习和训练及船岸联合演习是验证和增强应急反应能力的重要手段，详见第六
章。 
Emergency exercise and drills, and Ship- Shore joint drills are key methods to examine and increase 
emergency response capability. Refer to Chapter 6 for details.

Analyze and investigate the emergency，develop the handling measures under the team leader’s

organizations and relative salvage organizations; contacting charterer, P&I club, underwriter, lawyer

2.3.2 船管部经理：负责对主机失灵、火警、操舵系统故障、全船断电、船舶进水、溢油、

的联络，记录应急反应过程。 
Crew Department Manager: responsible for providing support under situation of man overboard, rescue 
the people in enclosed sp aces, and crew ’s heavy injury and illness, and contacting medical 
organization for treat, cure and medical information.  Takes charge of evaluation of the emergency

 Company’s emergency response procedure

Emergency initial response

   Action taken

式，保持通信畅通。 
Designated personnel shall make initial inquiry of the ship ’s condition according to the emergency, 
and exchange the way for contact later and ensure expedite communication. 
3.2.2 应急小组成员应尽可能详细地了解船舶所发生的紧急情况和面临的局面， 对于事态的

situation; evaluate the development tendency of the incident and reporting to the team leader.

information at hand, and arrange team members to analyze, study, and make implementation plan, and

船舶保安威胁   
Ship’s security threats

3.4.3 在公司允许的情况下接受新闻媒介采访，原则如下. 
Guidelines to be followed when accepting  the media`s interview under the  permission given by  the 
company. 
3.4.3.1 所表达的观点及语言应用应事先沟通确认许可; 
All opinions and choice of words to be used and conveyed to the media should be communicated and 
be approved by the management in advance. 
3.4.3.2 态度一定要诚恳，不确定的问题绝不回答，而委婉的让其咨询公司; 
The sincere should be portrayed when representing the company. One should never give a reply if one 
is uncertain of the answer. Instead, one should turn to seek clarification with the company. 
3.4.3.3 焦点应放在事故发生后的努力上； 
The focus should be on the rectification efforts and actions taken after the incident. 
3.4.3.3 讨论在一般情况下能发生什么，即：什么时候发生的，在什么地方发生的，为了控
制局面做了些什么？但决不要提及为什么发生； 
Discuss what can occur under normal circumstances, such as when it happened, where it happened, 
what actions have been taken to control the situation. Do not speculate on why and how it happened, 
leave the investigations to the appointed investigators. 
3.4.3.5 表示关切，但避免牵涉法律问题，例如：“公司对这起事件（某类事故）的发生感
到非常遗憾。我们正在尽全力控制局面。现正与有关当局及代理一起工作，对事实
进行评估并开始采取补救措施”； 
Express concerns towards the situation, but avoid discussing liabilities and legal issues. Once again, 
leave such discussions to the appointed investigators. For example, “The company deeply regret for 
the inconvenience caused by this incident, and the company is already trying the very best to control 
the situation. The company is already working closely with concerned authorities and agencies to 
investigate the matter and will take all possible remedies actions accordingly.”  
3.4.3.6 所提供的资料应是在相关“记录”的基础上； 
The data or materials provided should be based on the relevant “records”; 
3.4.3.7 保留一份所有与事件有关的出版物， 以及口头提供的所有资料的记录和分发给所有
有关公司职员材料的复印件。回答媒体应 始终如一, 保留对媒介提问／采访要求及
其安排的记录； 
Retain a copy of the published materials related to the case as well as all materials (including 
information provided verbally) provided or distributed to the media and company’ s own staff. The 
stand should be maintained/consistent when answering questions. Keep proper records of the media 
questions /interviews and a record of the arrangements. 
3.4.3.8 避免回答假设的问题、推测、猜测和猜想，避免透漏未公开的时间信息、油水数等
信息； 
Avoid to answering the hypothetical questions, speculations, assumptions and guesses. A void to 
provide the time information and quantity of oil or bunker and/or other material which were  not be 
public. 
3.4.3.9 不应泻露内部规定ˎ规则和公司商业机密； 
Management Instructions, confidential internal regulations, company rules and business trade secrets 
should not be disclosed. 
3.4.3.10 当发生重大事故和特别重要的事件时，如有必要，可指定专人负责信息发布，并
应关注网络信息的正确性，避免网络攻击。  
When major accidents and particularly important events occur, if necessary, a  specific person can be 
designated to responsible for information release, and attention to the correctness of network 
information, and avoid network attacks. 
3.5 其他 Others 
3.5.1 相关责任部门经理负责记录应急反应的全过程，并附所有相关的通讯文稿和记录。 
Managers of relative departments in charge shall record the whole process of emergency response, with

和船舶承租人（或其代理人）报告。各主管机关通信联系方法见本计划附录 3。

第四章  船舶应急反应程序 
Chapter 4 Ship’s Emergency Response Procedure 
 
1.0 船舶应急反应初步 
Initial stage of ship’s emergency response    
1.1 当船舶出现紧急情况或紧急情况的征兆时，发现人员应毫不迟疑的采取相应的措施以
控制局面，并立即报告船长或值班人员。例如发现火警，应立即发出火警警报。 
When the ship encounters or foresees emergency, the discoverer sha ll take proper measures at once to 
control the situation, and report to the Master or personnel on duty. For instance in case of fire, the fire 
alarm shall be released immediately. 
1.2 对于紧急情况的征兆，值班人员应立即采取措施控制局面，避免进一步发展成紧急情
况，同时报告船长。 
When emergency signs appear, the personnel on duty shall take proper measures to control the situation, 
in preventing its development to emergency, and report to the Master. 
1.3 船长得到报告后，应立即到驾驶室或相应的指挥地点指挥，了解和判断紧急情况的性
质和程度。如果确定船舶已发生紧急情况，船长应立即宣布启动船舶应急反应程序。 
The Master shall rush to the wheel house or relevant spots after receiving the report, get to know and 
decide the nature and extent of the emergency. If it is confirmed that the ship is in emergency, the Master 
shall declare to initiate the ship’s emergency response procedure. 
2.0 应变部署 
Emergency deployment 
2.1 船舶发出应变信号或广播时，全体船员应立即按照应变部署表规定的职责和任务，进
入相应的岗位或集合场所，进行规定的应急准备并听候命令。 
After the emergency  signal or broadcast released, all crews shall muster at corresponding positions or 
places according to the responsibility and obligation required in the Ship ’s Muster List , perform 
emergency preparations and wait for further commands.  
2.2 对于“货船应变部署表”未规定的紧急情况，由船长根据情况采取适当的方式召集船
员实施应急反应，必要时应使用警报。应急反应职责由船长根据实际情况决定，并参
见本计划第 5 章中的应急行动指南。 
For emergency not included in the “ Cargo Ship Muster List ”, the Master shall take proper method to 
muster the crew and implement emergency response, and release alarm when necessary. The Master shall 
decide responsibilities regarding emergency response based on real situation, and refer to the emergency 
response guidance specified in Chapter 5.  
2.3 船长是船舶应急反应的最高指挥者，船上所有人员都应服从船长的指挥，按照船长命
令和各自规定的职责实施应急行动。 
The Master is the supreme commander of the ship ’s emergency response, and everyone onboard shall 
obey Master ’s instructions, and implement emergency  measures as Master requests and relative 
responsibilities. 
2.4 船长应会同船舶安委会成员评估可能的存在风险，决定应对措施，及采取措施的方式
和方法。 
Master shall decide on the corresponding measures and the methods of implementation considering the 
potential risks evaluated by the members of the Ship’s Health & Safety Committee.

3.0 船长的行为准则 
Master’s code of conduct 
3.1 船长作为船舶的最高指挥者，在决定采取行动时应始终把船舶及人员的安全、避免环
境污染的最高利益放在首位。 
As the supreme commander, the Master shall always put ship and crew ’s safety and avoi ding 
environmental pollution in the highest benefit when taking actions.  
3.2 船长在决定采取相应的行动时，应特别注意可能产生的进一步危险和伤害，并做好相
应的准备。 
Master shall pay more attention to the further potential danger and damage when decides on the 
corresponding measures, and the related preparedness should be ready.  
3.3 船长应随时掌握事件现场的情况，对船舶所处的状态的安全情况进行不断的判断，决
定是否采取必要的预防措施和进一步的行动。 
Master shall have on -site information in hand at any time, and make consecutive judgments regarding 
ship’s safety, and decides whether to take necessary precaution or further action.  
3.4 船长应遵守港口国、沿岸国的报告规定（详见本章 4.0），及时建立与有关方的联系，
并指定专人负责保证通讯的畅通（详见本章 5.0）。 
Master shall comply with the regulations of each port country and coastal state (see Chapter 4.0), contact 
relevant parties in time, and designated person to maintain uninterrupted communication. 
3.5 船长应充分了解船舶对紧急情况的控制能力，以决定是否需要援助，并及时向第三方
求助（详见本章 6.0）。 
Master shall know well of the ship’s ability to control emergency, in order to decide whether assistance is 
needed, and to seek assistance from third party in time. 
3.6 船长在考虑弃船决定时应慎重，并尽可能取得公司批准 
Master shall be prudent when considering of abandoning the ship, and apply for approval from the 
company. 
4.0 报告程序 
Report procedure 
4.1 首次报告 
Initial report 
当船舶发生紧急情况，在采取各项应急措施的同时，船长应使用“船舶紧急情况首次
报告表”向公司报告，内容应尽量详细。如果情况危急，可先进行口头报告后再填报
该表。根据船舶现场情况，如船长认为必要时还应使用“船舶紧急情况补充报告表”
向公司报告事态的后续发展情况，取得公司的支持和指导。对于保安威胁按保安计划
实施应急行动。 
When the ship encounters emergency, the Master shall also report to the company in details as much as 
possible using “Emergency Initial Report” while taking emergency measures. In case of critical situation,

Follow-up Report

In case of pollution, report shall be submitted according to the requirements in SOPEP and port 
regulations. 
4.4 与第三方联系有关援助事项的通信应参照《船舶油污应急计划》或《国际危规》补充

The requirements and format of c ommunication with third party regarding assistance and salvage shall 
refer to SOPEP or IMDG code. 
5.0 应急通讯 
Emergency communication 
5.1 船长应及时与有关方建立可靠的联系，并能够使用多种通信方法。 
Master shall establish credible connection with relevant parties, and use various means of communication 
method.  
5.2 船舶应选择最快捷、最有效的通信方式发送应急通讯报文。 
Ship shall choose the most rapid and effective communication method to send emergency message. 
5.3 船舶在应急反应全过程中，应保持与公司或其他有关方的通信联系畅通，必要时应保
持通话联络在接通状态。 
During the whole emergency response period, the ship shall maintain the uninterrupted communication 
with company and relevant parties, and even remain the telephone communication  in the hold condition 
when necessary.  
6.0 向第三方求助 
Seek assistance from third party 
6.1 一般情况下，向第三方求助应经公司同意。如果事态发展至严重危及船员生命和船舶
安全，船长认为必须立即援助时，船长有权直接向第三方求助，同时向公司报告。 
Under normal condition, seeking assistance from the third party shall be approved by the company. 
However, if the emergency severely threats crews and ship’s safety and the Master considers it necessary 
to seek immediate assistance, the Master is authorized to turn to third party for assistance, and report to 
the company at meantime.  
6.2 选择的救助方应考虑救助的及时性和有效性，主要包括以下可能的救助者： 
Promptness and effectiveness shall be taken into consideration when selecting the salvers, which might 
include: 
 附近航行船舶或海上设施； 
Surrounding navigating ships or offshore facilities 
 近岸国家提供的救助；

6.4 船长在向第三方求助时，应把本船的情况通知救助方。 
Master shall inform the ship’s situation to the salver when seek assistance from the third party. 
6.5 在救助方到达前，船长应： 
Before the salver arrive, Master shall： 
 为援助船指示方位； 
Provide own position to the assistance ship; 
 为飞机做好着陆标志（需要时）； 
Set the landing mark for airplane (if needed);

Prepare sufficient communication devices and lighting equipment 
 通报船舶的情况、环境特点和事态发展情况； 
Report the ship’s condition, environment features and emergency development; 
 决定并与救助船协调救助方案； 
  Decides and coordinate with the assistance ship about the salvage plan; 
 与救助方协调现场通信方法； 
  Coordinate the on- site communication method with the salver; 
 控制局势，并做好局势恶化的准备工作。 
  Control the situation, and prepare for deterioration   
7.0 后续措施 
Follow-up measures 
7.1 通过采取应急行动，对事件进行了有效控制或消除了险情后，应对现场进行检查，确
定处置的效果。 
After measures are taken and the matter was controlled  or danger eliminated, on- site inspection shall be 
carried out in order to confirm the results. 
7.2 船长确认险情消除后应报告公司应急反应小组，获得小组组长同意后方可宣布船上应
急反应程序的结束，同时通知其他有关方面。 
After the Master confirm the elimination of danger, he shall report to the emergency response team, and 
declare the termination of the emergency response procedure with team leader’s approval, and also report 
to other relevant parties. 
7.3 船长应指示船员清理现场，必要时应安排人员在现场继续值守监视，以控制隐患。 
Master shall instruct the crew to clean the site, and arrange personnel on duty when necessary, in order to 
detect hidden danger. 
7.4 相关人员应按照规定对事件和处理情况进行记录，并做好海事处理工作。 
Relevant staff shall record the matter and handling process as stipulated, and well handle marine affairs.  
7.5 应急反应的过程应记入航海日志，如须记录的内容太多，可另作详细的专项记录。

第五章 船舶应急反应指南 
Chapter 5 Ship’s Emergency Response guideline 
 
1.0 主机失灵 
Main engine failure 
当船舶发生主机失控紧急情况时，应立即采取以下行动： 
Following immediate actions should be taken in the event of main engine failure: 
1.1 值班驾驶员的行动： 
The actions of Officer On Watch (OOW): 
1.1.1 立即采取应急行动以避免碰撞、搁浅等事故的发生，如：利用余速，用舵控制船的
运动。 
Emergency actions shall be taken immediately to avoid accidents such as collision and grounding, e.g. 
using inertial velocity and control the ship with rudder. 
1.1.2 报告船长。 
Report to Master. 
1.1.3 显示失控的号灯或号型；并在船舶恢复动力后取消此号灯或号型。 
Exhibit the lights or shapes of not under command; and call off the lights or shapes after ship’s power 
system is restored. 
1.1.4 在 VHF16 频道告知附近其它船舶注意。 
Alert other ships in the vicinity by broadcasting on VHF channel 16. 
1.1.5 改用人工操舵。 
Change over to hand steering operation. 
1.1.6 如船舶是沿岸航行，尽可能操纵船舶使其远离岸边。 
If ship is navigating in coastal water, try best to manoeuvre the ship far away from the shore. 
1.1.7 计算船舶漂移方向和速度。 
Calculate the drifting direction and speed of the ship. 
1.2 值班轮机员的行动： 
 The actions of Engineer on watch: 
1.2.1 根据当时的情况，转为集控室或机旁控制。 
Change to control in engine control room or on-site control according to on site situation. 
1.2.2 报告驾驶台和轮机长。 
Report to the wheelhouse and Chief Engineer. 
1.2.3 经过对直接原因和其他可能性的分析，按轮机长的指令采取应急行动。 
Analyze the direct and other possible reasons, and take emergency measures under Chief Engineer’s 
instruction. 
1.3 轮机长和其他轮机员的行动： 
 Chief Engineer and other engineers’ actions: 
1.3.1 当轮机长察觉或得到报告，应立即进入机舱集控室并指挥应急行动。 
      When the Chief Engineer detects or reported with emergency, he shall rush in the engine control 
room and instruct the emergency measures.  
1.3.2 其他轮机员应直接进入机舱集控室并按轮机长指示行动。 
     Other engineers shall enter the engine control room immediately and act as Chief Engineer 
commands.

1.4 船长的行动 
Master’s action 
船长在得到报告或察觉到主机异常，应立即到驾驶台指挥。 
Master shall rush in the wheel house immediately when detects or reported w ith abnormality of the 
main engine. 
1.4.1 布置 
     Arrangement 
 加强驾驶台的瞭望； 
Improve lookouts from the wheelhouse; 
 多种手段定位，确定船舶漂移方向和速度，观察周围船舶动向，测量水深，计
算潮汐、流向，观测天气和海况等； 
Fix position  by various methods, confirm ship’ s drifting direction and speed, observe  the 
movement of  other ships in the vicinity, check water depth, calculate tide and  current, and 
observe weather and sea condition, etc.; 
 在可抛锚水域备锚，以便应急使用； 
Stand by anchors within sea areas that anchors can be dropped in case of emergency; 
 视情况向公司、有关当局或部门报告。 
Report to company and relevant authorities as appropriate. 
1.4.2 处理 
     Handling 
 判断船舶的位置和运动趋势，了解机损情况，组织船员修理； 
Assess the ship’s location and drifting tendency, realize engine damage, and arrange crew for 
repair; 
 如不能立即修妥，应根据当时的环境尽量保持船舶在安全水域。如果可能，应
将船舶移至稳妥位置抛锚，再由船员进行修理； 
If repair was not able to be completed in a very short time, ship shall be maintained within safe 
sea area based on the prevailing circumstances and conditions. If possible, ship shall be shifted to 
safe sea area and repair shall be conducted after dropping anchor; 
 如船员自力无法修复，应尽快向公司报告，并根据当时的环境（船位、天气、
海况和机损情况等）准备一份符合救助合同程序的求助信息。如有足够的时间，
应遵守公司的有关指示（参见本手册第五章 15.0－救助－规定）。 
Under circumstances that crew cannot repair the damage, company shall be reported as soon as 
possible, and messages for seeking assistance in accordance with the rescue procedure shall be 
prepared according to the prevailing circumstances and conditions (ship’s position, weather, sea 
condition and engine damage, etc.). If time permitted, relevant instructions of the company shall 
be complied (see Chapter 51.0 – Rescue -- Regulations). 
2.0 操舵系统故障 
Steering Gear Failure 
当驾驶台遥控操舵装置控制系统（AUTO、FOLLOW-UP、NON-FOLLOW-UP）发
生故障时，应立即采取下列措施： 
When remote operating of steering gear at wheelhouse fails (AUTO, FOLLOW-UP, NON-FOLLOW 
UP), following measures shall be taken: 
2.1 值班驾驶员的行动 
The actions of OOW (Officer on Watch) 
2.1.1 立即报告船长和轮机长。

      Report to the Master and Chief Engineer immediately. 
2.1.2 改用另一台舵机，如仍无舵效，则 
     Change over to another steering gear; if still malfunctioned, then 
2.1.3 命令一名舵工携带对讲机到舵机房执行机旁应急操舵。 
     Instruct one helmsman to perform on-site emergency steering in steering gear room with

2.1.4 电话通知机舱值班轮机员遥控操舵系统故障，立即备主机、降速。 
     Telephone the engineer on watch the failure of remote control of steering gear, and standby main

2.1.5 与舵机房建立直通电话/对讲机联系并执行机旁应急操舵。

When connections mentioned above are failed, the officer on watch OOW shall give the wheel 
orders from public address. 
2.1.7 显示失控的号灯或号型；并在恢复对船舶的控制后取消。 
Exhibit the lights or shapes of not under command; and eliminate them after control of the ship is 
restored. 
2.1.8 在 VHF16 频道告知附近其它船舶。 
Alert other ships in the vicinity by broadcasting on VHF channel 16. 
2.1.9 采取任何可能的手段避免船舶面临的危险。 
Undertake whatever action necessary to avoid any dangers faced by the ship. 
2.1.10 记录操舵系统故障的时间、船位和采取的措施。 
Record the time, ship’s position and measure taken of steering gear system failure. 
2.2 值班轮机员的行动 
The actions of engineer on watch 
2.2.1 立即到舵机房进行应急操舵，待舵工接替后回到机舱。 
Perform on-site emergency steering immediately in steering gear room, and return to engine room 
after the helmsman reaches the position. 
2.2.2 初步检查故障原因，并向驾驶台和轮机长报告。 
Perform initial inspection on the cause of failure, and report to the wheelhouse and Chief Engineer. 
2.2.3 接到驾驶台通知后尽快备主机。 
Standby main engine after notified by the wheelhouse. 
2.2.4 按轮机长指示采取其他应急措施。 
Take other emergency actions under Chief Engineer’s instructions. 
2.3 轮机长的行动 
Chief Engineer’s actions 
2.3.1 接到操舵系统故障通知后，立即下到机舱指挥。 
Reach the engine room immediately to command after notified with steering gear system failure. 
2.3.2 安排轮机员在水手到达舵机之前根据驾驶台舵令进行机旁应急操舵。 
Arrange engineers perform on- site emergency steering according to wheel house’s instructions, until 
the helmsman arrives. 
2.3.3 根据船长命令安排尽快备主机。 
Standby main engine according to Master’s instruction. 
2.3.4 安排查找故障原因，尽快进行抢修，并在修妥后通知驾驶台。

Arrange inspection on failure, repair as soon as possible, and inform the wheelhouse once repaired.

Master’s actions 
2.4.1 接到操舵系统故障通知后，立即上驾驶台指挥。 
Reach to wheelhouse immediately after informed with steering gear system failure. 
2.4.2 根据周围船舶通航密度和气象、海况情况，合理操纵船舶，避免船舶面临的危险，
视情况备妥双锚，以便应急使用。 
Maneuver the ship properly according to traffic density in the vicinity, weather, sea condition, etc, to 
avoid dangers faced by the ship, and standby double anchors in case of emergency.  
2.4.3 视情况 （如正在进出港、 在分道通航控制区域） 将舵机失灵情况通知有关港口当局，

According to the prevailing circumstances and conditions  (e.g. entering or  leaving from the ports, 
navigating within the area of traffic separation scheme), report to relevant port authorities with the 
steering gear failure, as well as the emergency response team of the company, report details please 
refer to Chapter 4.0. 
2.4.4 恢复正常航行后，安排将应急反应的过程记入航海日志。 
Record the process of emergence response into deck logbook after resumed on voyage.  
3.0 全船断电 
Ship’s Blackout 
全船断电由以下可能的原因造成 
Ship’s blackout caused by the following possible reasons 
 电站本身的故障； 
Failure of the power station; 
 发生大电流、过负荷情况； 
Experience of heavy current or overload; 
 大功率电机故障或启动控制箱的延时发生变化； 
Failure of high-power motor or change of delay action in the control box  
 发电机及其原动机本身的故障；以及 
       Failure of the generator and its prime motor; or  
 操作失误。 
Misoperation. 
3.1 值班轮机员的行动 
The action of engineer on watch 
3.1.1 报告驾驶台。 
     Report to the wheelhouse. 
3.1.2 报告电机员和轮机长。 
Report to the electrician engineer and Chief Engineer. 
3.1.3 转为机舱集控室控制，并将车钟放在停车位置。 
Change over to control in the engine control room, and put telegraph handle to stop. 
3.1.4 启动备用的发电机。 
Start the generator in spare. 
3.1.5 确定重要设备的启动顺序。 
Ascertain the starting procedure of important equipments. 
3.1.6 按轮机长指示重新运行主机。 
Re-start main engine under Chief Engineer’s instruction.

3.2 值班驾驶员的行动 
    The action of Officer on Watch 
3.2.1 报告船长。 
Report to the Master. 
3.2.2 关闭电罗经电源开关，检查磁罗经工作情况并记录。 
Switch off the power of the gyro compass, and check the working condition of magnetic compass. 
3.2.3 检查舵机电源供应、航行设备、应急照明情况。 
Check steering gear power supply, navigational equipments and emergency lighting.  
3.2.4 如操舵系统尚能工作，应改为使用手操舵。 
If the steering gear system still function, hand steering operation shall be adopted. 
3.2.5 显示失控号灯或号型；并在船舶恢复动力后取消此号灯或号型。 
Display the lights or shapes of not under command; and call off the lights or shapes after ship’s 
power system is restored.

Alert other ships in the vicinity by broadcasting on VHF channel 16. 
3.2.7 确定并记录失电时的时间和船位，以及事件的过程和采取的措施。 
Ascertain the time and ship’s position of blackout, and process of the event and measures taken. 
3.3 轮机长的行动 
   Chief Engineer’s actions 
3.3.1 当轮机长得知全船断电时，应直接到机舱集控室指挥。 
Chief Engineer shall reach to the engine control room when informed with blackout. 
3.3.2 其他轮机员和电机员应直接到机舱集控室并按轮机长的指示采取行动。 
Other engineers and electricians  engineer shall arrive at the engine control room immediately and 
take measures under Chief Engineer’s instructions. 
3.3.3 调查故障的直接原因和其他可能的原因，尽快恢复船舶动力。 
Check the direct and other possible reasons for blackout, and try best to restore ship’s power. 
3.4  船长的行动 
    Master’s action 
3.4.1 得知全船断电后，应立即到驾驶台指挥。 
Reach the wheel house immediately after informed with blackout. 
3.4.2 必要时，命大副、木匠尽可能备妥双锚应急使用。  
Instruct the Chief Officer and carpenter  to standby both anchors  as soon as possible  in case of 
emergency.

      Record the process of emergence response into deck logbook after resumed on passage. Report the

应急计划                                   版本/修改：3.0/2.0                              CONP-05

Initial response in case of fire alarm 
4.1.1 当船员发现失火时， 应该立即大声呼喊， 启动最近的火警报警装置或通过其他有效
的办法发布火警消息， 并立即采取可能的手段灭火或者控制火势。 如果火势不能控
制， 切断通往火场的电源， 关闭有关通风设施， 关闭失火处所的门 （注意不能锁死） ，
守候在门旁等待灭火人员的到来。 
Crews shall shout loudly when discover a fire, press the nearest fire alarm switch or release fire 
message through other effective ways, and take proper measures to put out or control the fire. If the 
fire is out of control, power supply to the fire scene shall be cut off, ventilation device s shall be shut 
down, and doors around the fire scene shall be closed (not locked). Waiting at the doors until firemen 
arrive. 
4.1.2 值班驾驶员得到失火消息时的行动： 
The OOW action when informed on fire: 
 报告船长; 
Report to the Master; 
 通过船上的通用警报系统、气笛和公共广播系统发出警报，使全船人员明确火
灾发生位置； 
Raise fire alarm using general alarm system onboard, siren and public address system, inform all 
crews with position of fire; 
 通知集控室； 
Inform the engine control room; 
 在现场情况允许的情况下，尽量操纵船舶减少风对火势的影响； 
If situation permits, try best to maneuver the ship so that influence of the wind to the fire can be 
reduced; 
 在 VHF16 频道告知附近其他船舶； 
Alert other ships in the vicinity by broadcasting on VHF channel 16; 
 开启甲板照明灯(夜间)。 
Turn on the deck lights (nighttime). 
4.2 应变部署 
Emergency muster 
4.2.1 船长听到火警警报后应立即到驾驶台指挥 
     Master shall immediately reach the wheelhouse after alarm raised 
 采取有利于控制火势蔓延的航行方法：通常应采取减速、停车并操纵船舶使失
火地点处于下风，有助于控制火势的蔓延； 
Take proper maneuver method to the benefit of controlling the spread of fire: usually by reducing 
speed, stopping engine, and manoeuver the ship to make the fire scene on the lee side , which 
helps with controlling the spread of fire; 
 启动应急程序，取得现场情况并做出相应反应； 
Activate emergency response procedure,  obtain on- site information and decide the next action  
accordingly; 
 给现场指挥下达命令； 
Give orders to on scene commander; 
 向公司报告； 
Report to the company; 
 与第三方联系（有关的港口当局、代理、附近的船舶）； 
Contact with the third parties (relevant port authorities, agents, and ships in the vicinity);

 确认每一应急分队人数，有无人员受伤或失踪； 
Confirm numbers of crew members each team, and if anyone injured or missing; 
 救助人员； 
Perform salvation; 
 如果发现有人员受伤或失踪，首先搜索和救助人员； 
  If anyone was found injured or missing, searching and salvation shall be conducted first; 
 如果需要，请求附近的船舶或岸上协助搜索和救助人员。 
Request ships in the vicinity or people on shore to assist for searching and rescue if necessary. 
4.2.2 全体船员的行动 
     All crew members’ actions 
听到消防警报后， 所有船员应在2 分钟内赶到指定集合地点， 按照消防部署表所指
派的任务，佩戴好个人防护用品、携带灭火器材向本队队长报告。 
各队队长现场进行点名，保证本队所有工作准备就绪，并向现场指挥员(大副或轮
机长。机舱失火，轮机长负责现场指挥)报告。现场指挥员根据现场情况向各组下
达指示并向船长报告，各队成员根据指示按自己应变职责进行行动。 
After the alarm raised, all crewmembers shall reach the muster station in 2 minutes, wearing personal 
protective equipment and bring fire -fighting equipment according to the responsibilit ies in the fire 
muster list and report to the team leader , the team leader shall take head count , and get ready the 
preparedness respectively and report to the on scene commander (Chief Officer or Chief Engineer, 
Chief Engineer acts as  the on scene commander in case of a fire in engine room ). On scene 
commander shall deliver instructions to each team and report to the Master, and all crewmembers 
shall take proper actions according to their responsibilities. 
 灭火队 
Fire fighting team 
 现场指挥员检查消防员穿戴情况并向船长报告，根据船长指示采取进一步的行
动，包括命令消防员在协助人员的帮助下进入火场查探火情； 
The on scene commander shall check the fireman’s unit and report to the Master, and take further 
actions under Master’s instructions, including commanding the fireman to approach the fire scene 
for inspecting the fire with assistance of other personnel; 
 消防员应采取多种手段与外界协助人员保持不间断地联系。在探明火情后，如
果可行，消防员应就近取用灭火设施或工具扑灭或者控制火势。如果火势难以
控制则应尽快撤出火场向现场指挥员报告，现场指挥员在清楚失火情况后向船
长报告，在得到指示后进行灭火操作； 
Fireman shall try different ways contacting people out of the fire scene constantly. After 
investigating fire, they shall fight fire or control fire with fire-fighting equipment or tools if 
feasible. If fire grows out of control , they shall evacuate immediately and report to the on -site 
commander. Commander shall report to the Master after clarification of the fire condition, and 
perform fire extinguish under Master’s instruction; 
 其他人员备妥灭火设备，听候命令准备施放。 
Other personnel shall prepare fire-fighting equipment and perform under instruction. 
 隔离队 
Segregation team 
 进行点名并报告现场指挥员； 
Take attendance and report to the commander; 
 根据指示关闭门窗、舱口、风机、挡火板等；

Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.   Effective Date: 20 20/02/14                  Page: 8/34 
Close windows and doors, hatch covers, fan, and fire dampers, etc.; 
 给灭火队以支持； 
Support the fire-fighting team; 
 切断局部电路； 
Cut off part of electric circuit; 
 搬开近火处的易燃物品，阻止火势蔓延。 
Remove inflammable materials near fire, in preventing spreading of fire. 
 救护队 
First-aid team 
 听取现场指挥员的命令，做好随时救助伤员的准备。 
Obey commander’s orders, and prepare for saving the injured. 
 机舱固定人员 
Fixed staff in engine room 
 备好主机，根据驾驶台指示操纵主机； 
Standby the main engine, and operate it under instructions from the wheelhouse; 
 启动消防泵，做好启动应急消防泵的准备； 
Start the fire pumps, and prepare for activating the emergency fire pumps; 
 根据船长指示保持有关泵的运转。 
Keep the running of relevant pumps under the Master’s instruction. 
4.3 探火和判断 
Explore fire and judgment 
4.3.1 现场指挥员应尽快确定： 
     Commander on- site shall ascertain as fast as possible: 
 火灾的类别； 
Type of fire; 
 合适的灭火剂； 
Suitable fire extinguisher; 
 合适的扑救方法； 
Proper extinguishing method; 
 如何防止火灾扩散； 
How to prevent fire from spreading; 
 灭火任务和所需的人力； 
Extinguishing tasks and labor needed; 
 有无人员被困。 
If anyone gets victim. 
4.3.2 正确的判断取决于准确的信息，现场指挥员的信息来源可通过如下方式：  
     Correct judgments originated from accurate in formation, and the commander shall obtain 
information through/based on: 
 询问发现者； 
Inquiring the discoverer; 
 平时对失火处所、所载货物的了解情况； 
Familiarization of the fire scene and cargo loaded onboard; 
 失火现场的外部观察； 
External observation of the fire scene; 
 组织人员探火等。

Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.   Effective Date: 20 20/02/14                  Page: 9/34 
Arranging fireman for exploration.  
4.4 灭火注意事项 
  Notes for fire extinguishing 
4.4.1 使用水灭火: 
Fight fire with water: 
 使用水灭火可导致船舶稳性损失和增加吃水； 
Using water to extinguish fire might cause loss to the ship’s stability and increase draft； 
 谷物接触水后会膨胀，对船体造成损坏。 
Grain might swell up when get access to water, which may cause damage to hull structure. 
4.4.2 使用大型灭火系统 
     Use fixed extinguishing system 
 需要确定灭火剂使用数量； 
Make sure of the number of fire extinguisher needed; 
 失火处所要完全封闭。 
The fire scene shall be segregated. 
4.5 海上失火时应注意： 
When fire on sea, shall: 
4.5.1 通知公司； 
Inform the company; 
4.5.2 如果有人员严重受伤，请求最近的救助中心救助； 
Seek help from the nearest rescue center if anyone is injured; 
4.5.3 如果发生油污，通知最近的主管当局； 
Inform the nearest administration when oil spill; 
4.5.4 如果火情可以控制直到船舶到达最近的港口，立即通知该港口当局和代理： 
If fire could be controlled , approach the nearest port, the port authority and agent shall be informed 
immediately with: 
 火的种类、范围、位置； 
Type, scale and location of the fire; 
 船上装载的货物； 
Cargo loaded onboard; 
 船上灭火的能力。 
The ability of fire extinguishing onboard. 
4.6 港内失火时应注意： 
 When fire at port, shall： 
4.6.1 停止所有货物和船上作业。 
Suspend all cargo operation. 
4.6.2 通知港口当局和代理。 
Inform the port authority and agent. 
4.6.3 通知公司。 
Notify the company. 
4.6.4 核实是否有人员伤亡。 
Check if anyone gets casualty. 
4.6.5 尽力灭火直至岸上灭火队到达。 
Try best to fight fire until shore fire-fighting team arrives. 
4.6.6 与岸上灭火队保持联系。 

37

应急计划                                   版本/修改：3.0/2.0                              CONP-05 
Contingency Plan                             Version/Revise: 3.0/2.0                            CONP -05 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                       生效日期：2020/02/14                    第10/34页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.   Effective Date: 20 20/02/14                  Page: 10/34 
Keep to contacts with shore fire-fighting team. 
4.6.7 根据公司指示，与当地船东互保协会联系。 
Keep to contact with local P&I club under the company’s instruction. 
5.0 船舶进水 
Flooding  
5.1 立即采取的行动： 
    Following measures shall be taken:  
5.1.1 发出堵漏应变警报。 
Sound flooding alarm. 
5.1.2 根据本船的破损控制图将各层甲板及货舱的水密舱室界限上的一切开口迅速关闭。 
Close all openings at all decks watertight compartments according to “Damage Control Plan of the 
ship. 
5.1.3 减速停车将破损部位放在下风，减少进水量。 
Reduce speed and stop the engine, put the damage part at leeward side, in order to reduce flooding. 
5.1.4 一旦货舱进水， 如条件许可， 应立即采取调整航向、 降速直至停车的措施以减少水
对船舶结构的冲击，同时进入弃船应急部署。 
Once the cargo holds were flooded and circumstances permit, measures such as adjusting course , 
reducing speed and stopping engine, in order to reduce the impact from the water to the ship’ s hull, 
and start the Abandon ship. 
5.2 查明损漏情况 
Find out the leakage circumstances 
通过观察、测量和计算对损漏情况作出准确判断。 
Make correct judgment of the leakage circumstances through observation, sounding and calculation. 
5.2.1 测量各油、水舱、干隔舱和污水井，摸清其水位变化；测量时注意舱内有无水声；
双层底还应注意有无空气从空气管中冒出。 
Sound each oil fuel tank, water tank, void space an d bilge well, and get to know  the variation of 
water level; check if there is water sound inside the holds; for double bottom, check if air released 
from the air pipe.  
5.2.2 装有大舱进水报警系统的船舶，可利用其帮助判断进水的舱室和水位。 
For ships equipped with ingress alarm, it can be used to ascertain the flooding holds and water level.  
5.2.3 对油、水舱的进水，还可取样检验油里的水分或淡水中有无海水渗入。 
For flooding oil and water tanks, sample can be taken to test if seawater is mixed inside.  
5.2.4 货舱进水， 尽可能进舱检查漏水位置， 记下肋位及离甲板高度。 如果破孔在舱内水
位之下，可从气泡和水声来判断。 
If cargo holds are flooded, lea kage location shall be verified, and frame location  and height towards 
deck shall be marked. If the hole is found under water level, judgment can be made based on the 
location bubbles are seen or water heard. 
5.2.5 舷侧破孔位置可用自制探测器进行探测，如发现有吸力处，则破孔就在该处。 
Detector can be used to detect location of hole at ship’s sides, and the hole shall be located where the 
suction is found.  
5.2.6 检查舱壁、轴隧、管系等水密装置是否震裂、损坏或渗漏。 
Check if the watertight device of bulkhead, shaft tunnel, and piping system is shattered cracks, 
damaged or leaky.  
5.2.7 通过船舶下沉、纵横倾、漏油、冒气泡等现象可帮助判断破损的情况。 
Ascertain damage through ship’s sinking, trimming and listing, oil leakage, and bubbling. 

38

05_10_2.chapter: 第五章 船舶应急反应指南
05_10_2.text:
应急计划                                   版本/修改：3.0/2.0                              CONP-05 
Contingency Plan                             Version/Revise: 3.0/2.0                            CONP -05

Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.   Effective Date: 20 20/02/14                  Page: 11/34 
5.2.8 用相应的公式计算进水的速度。 
Use corresponding formula to calculate flooding speed. 
5.3 采取相应的堵漏措施 
Take proper measures of leakage stoppage 
5.3.1 组织排水。 
Arrange draining of water. 
5.3.2 进行堵漏抢险必须在查明破损的位置的进水情况后进行。 
Leakage stoppage shall be conducted after clarifying the flooding situation and position of the 
damage. 
5.3.3 保持船体平衡： 密切注意船舶的浮性和稳性， 并且在保证浮性和稳性的前提下采取
措施使船舶恢复正浮，以免倾覆。 
Maintain the balance of the ship: pay attention to the ship ’s buoyancy and stability, and take 
measures to restore even keel and prevent capsizing on the premise of guaranteeing the buoyancy and 
stability. 
5.3.4 尽快将漏损的情况报告公司。 
Report the leakage to the company as soon as possible. 
5.3.5 接到公司的指导方案后，参照执行。 
Implement the instruction from the company. 
5.3.6 船长认为需要弃船、 抢滩或拖救时， 应尽可能报公司同意后执行。 情况紧急来不及
请示时，尽量将所执行的行动报告公司。 
When Master considers of abandon ship, beaching or towing, he shall report to the company first and 
conduct correspondingly after permission. If emergency does not permit previ ous requests, report to 
the company with measures taken.  
6.0 碰撞 
Collision 
应采取一切措施避免碰撞或减小损失，如： 
    Take every measure to avoid collision or reduce damage, e.g.:  
 最大程度地使用主机、舵以改变航向或船速； 
Try to use the main engine and rudder for changing course or speed;  
 视情况使用单锚或双锚制动； 
Use single or double anchor(s) to stop vessel as appropriate; 
 在受限水域，如水深足以允许船舶顺利地脱浅，甚至可以主动使船搁浅并使用双
锚，但应注意可能造成船舶底部破损而造成污染； 
Within restricted water, if the water depth allows ship to refloat easily, even voluntary grounding 
the ship with double anchors ca n be adopted, but possible damage to the ship’ s bottom and 
pollution shall also be taken into consideration. 
 当碰撞不可避免时，应尽量操纵船舶避免本船船舯部位和机舱部位被撞击。 
When collision is unavoidable, try your best maneuver ship to avoid being collided the amidships 
and engine room in the accident.   
6.1 应急处置 
    Emergency treatment 
6.1.1 以船首撞入他船船侧的船舶在天气和海况允许的情况下不应立即倒出， 而应尽量保
持相互原有状态以减少被撞船舶进水。 当两船均确认无沉没危险时， 甚至可以用系
缆保持两船碰撞时的姿态， 以便进行排水、 堵漏和加强水密隔舱壁的工作； 天气不
良或有浪涌时两船应分离，以避免进一步的损害或火灾的发生。 

39

应急计划                                   版本/修改：3.0/2.0                              CONP-05

The ship whose bow collided into other ship’ s sides shall not run astern immediately if weather and 
sea condition permits, in order to reduce water flooded into collided ships. If both two ships are 
confirmed with no sinking risk, mooring lines can be used to maintain the ship’ s collision position 
for conducting draining, leakage stoppage and watertight compartments reinforcement; if weather is 
severe or sea is heavy, two ships shall be separated in order to prevent further damage or fire. 
6.1.2 被他船船首撞及船侧的船舶， 应尽可能立即停船以减少进水速度， 并立即进入堵漏
排水部署。 
Ship’s sides that are collided by other ships bow, shall stop the engine to reduce  the flooding speed, 
and start leakage stoppage and drain muster..  
6.1.3 为保护破损部位便于进行堵漏排水工作， 在不是两舷同时受损情况下， 应尽可能操
纵船舶使破损部位处于下风侧。 
In order to protect the damage and conduct leakage stoppage and draining operation, the ship shall be 
maneuver so that the damage part is at lee side under the circumstances that the two sides of the ship 
are not damaged at the same time. 
6.1.4 关闭相关的水密门窗和其他开口，避免进水范围扩大。 
Close relevant watertight doors, windows and other openings, in order to prevent spreading of 
flooded area.   
6.2 判断 
Judgment 
船长在全面评估所处局面后应就以下问题做出判断： 
Master shall evaluate the situation entirely and judge on following questions:   
6.2.1 如采取必要的堵漏措施减慢进水速度后，船舶可否继续自力航行。 
Whether ship can sail on her own after leakage stoppage, which reduces the flooding speed. 
6.2.2 是否需要请求拖航。 
Whether need towing. 
6.2.3 是否需要抢滩，并有适合的抢滩地点。 
Whether need beaching, and if proper beaching location is nearby. 
6.2.4 是否需要弃船。 
If abandon ship is necessary. 
6.3 在不危及本船和本船人员的情况下，船长应尽力救助他船并： 
Master shall rescue other ship to his best under circumstances that his ship and crew onboard are not 
threatened. 
6.3.1 互通船名、呼号和 IMO 号码。 
Exchange ships’ names, call signs and IMO No.  
6.3.2 将本船的船籍港、启航港及目的港通知他船。 
Inform the ship’s register port, sailing port and destination port to other ships. 
6.3.3 详细记录碰撞过程，概要记入航海日志。 
Record detailed collision process, and abstract enter into the logbook. 
6.3.4 查清自己的损失。 
Clarify the loss. 
6.3.5 通知船东和附近的主管当局。 
Notify the shipowner and port authorities in charge nearby. 
6.3.6 警告他船相关的航行危险。 
Warn other ships about the relevant navigation risk. 
6.3.7 守候另一船舶并向其提供帮助，直到不再需要时为止。 

40

应急计划                                   版本/修改：3.0/2.0                              CONP-05 
Contingency Plan                             Version/Revise: 3.0/2.0                            CONP -05

Watch the ship and provide assistance, until no needed. 
6.3.8 按“船舶应急计划”的规定，报告事故性质、原因、经过及结果，并写出碰撞责任
通知书，直接或间接地交对方船长签署。 
Report accident’s nature, reason, process and result according to “Ship’s contingency plan”, and 
write collision liability notice and hand it directly or indirectly to the other ship’s Master for 
signature. 
6.4 在非紧迫危险状态时 
Under non imminent danger situation 
碰撞后，应立即进入应变部署进行堵漏和排水及消防工作。 
Launch emergency deployment immediately after collision and conduct leakage stoppage, draining 
operation and fire prevention. 
6.4.1 自力航行 
While Independent navigation 
自力航行宜十分谨慎。若选择自力航行至最近的港口进行检查修理，船长应确认： 
Navigation independently shall be chosen with caution. If ship is about to sail to the nearest port for 
repair, the Master shall confirm that: 
 自力航行不会进一步危及船舶安全； 
       Independent navigation will not further threat the ship ’s safety; 
 主、辅机运转正常； 
Main and auxiliary engines function well; 
 进水得到有效控制并仍保留一定储备浮力； 
Flooding is under control and ship still keeps enough reserve buoyancy;  
 船舶浮态和稳性符合航行要求； 
Ship’s buoyancy and stability meets sailing requirements; 
 救生设备可正常启用。 
Life equipment is available. 
6.4.2 不能自力自航行时： 
While unable navigation independently 
宜采用拖航，拖航时应力求使破损部位不要受到风浪或迎流的冲击。 
If towage is adopted, and the damaged part shall not be hit by the wind or waves under towing 
condition. 
6.4.3 抢滩 
Beaching 
 当船舶大量进水无法堵漏而面临沉没危险时，或者船舶既不能自力航行，又难
于拖航或在拖航中难以为继时，应果断地实施抢滩。 
Beaching is suggested when the ship is severely flooded and cannot operate leakage stoppage while 
facing with sinking, or when the ship cannot sail independently and hard to be towed or continue 
the towage. 
 抢滩是为紧急避险而所采取的主动搁浅措施，目的是争取时间实施自救或等待
救援而免至船舶灭失。 
Beaching is a voluntary grounding in order to avoid further danger, and aims at buying more time 
for self-salvation or waiting for other assistance before the ship is destroyed.  
 船长应选择对可能船舶结构造成伤害最小，并容易获得救助的抢滩地点。 
Master shall choose the beaching position where the ship can be damaged to minimum and 
salvation easy. 

41

应急计划                                   版本/修改：3.0/2.0                              CONP-05 
Contingency Plan                             Version/Revise: 3.0/2.0                            CONP -05 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                       生效日期：2020/02/14                    第14/34页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.   Effective Date: 20 20/02/14                  Page: 14/34 
 抢滩后船舶进入“搁浅”应急程序。 
船舶沉没、毁灭不可避免时，船长应作出弃船决定。船舶进入“弃船”应急程序。 
  After beaching, the ship, starts grounding emergency procedure. 
When sinking and destruction of the ship is unavoidable, the Master shall declare abandon ship . 
The ship therefore starts abandonment emergency procedure. 
7.0 搁浅 
   Grounding 
7.1 应采取的行动 
    Take actions 
7.1.1 值班驾驶员应立即采取的行动 
     The officer on watch on watch shall at once: 
 停车，并通知船长和机舱船舶已搁浅； 
   Stop the engine and report to the Master and engine room that the ship is grounded; 
 标绘船舶位置，记录搁浅当时的船首向、底质、风力和海况情况； 
Fix the ship’s position, and record the bow direction, the nature of holding ground, wind force and 
sea condition, etc.; 
 记录测深仪数据； 
Record the depth on sounder; 
 显示号灯和/或号型。 
Display light and/or shape. 
7.1.2 船长的行动 
Master’s actions 
 命令大副组织实测船舶周围水深，绘出船舶草图，并标出搁浅前后的吃水读数，
按测深数据标出海底轮廓，并记下时间。 
Command the Chief Officer to arrange sounding water depth around  the ship, draw ship’ s draft, 
mark the fore and aft draft, draw bottom contour according to the sounder, and record time. 
 命令大副和轮机长组织测量所有的液体舱、货舱污水、干隔舱和机舱污水。 
Command the Chief Officer and the Chief Engineer to arrange sounding on liquid tanks, cargo hold 
bilge, void space and sludge/slop and dirty bilge tanks in engine room.  
7.1.3 计算潮水变化趋势，特别是下次高潮和低潮的潮高和时间。 
Calculate the variation tendency of tides, especially the height and time for next high tide and low 
tide. 
7.1.4 检查气象、风向和风速、流向和流速。 
Check the weather, wind direction and speed, current direction, and speed.  
7.1.5 安排检查船舶周围是否存在油迹，采取措施减少泄漏。 
Check if oil spots are found around the ship, take proper measures to reduce oil spillage. 
7.1.6 基于对上述船舶平衡、稳性计算、以及可能的螺旋桨和舵的损坏等情况，慎重考   
虑是否实施脱浅。 
Be cautious with refloating based on ship’ s balance, calculation on stability, and possible damage to 
propeller and rudder, etc.  
7.1.7 在试图脱浅之前， 对船位、 船舶周围情况， 以及螺旋桨、 舵、 主机和舵机的损坏 情
况进行彻底检查。 
Before refloating, inspect thoroughly the ship ’s position, ship’ s surrounding environment, and 
condition of the propeller, rudder, main engine and steering gear.  

42

05_10_3.chapter: 第五章 船舶应急反应指南
05_10_3.text:
应急计划                                   版本/修改：3.0/2.0                              CONP-05 
Contingency Plan                             Version/Revise: 3.0/2.0                            CONP -05 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                       生效日期：2020/02/14                    第15/34页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.   Effective Date: 20 20/02/14                  Page: 15/34 
7.1.8 以最快捷的方式通知公司， 并以适当的间隔期向公司进行后续报告， 每两个小时 或
公司指示的时间间隔。 
Inform the company through most effective way, and keep follow -up reports to company at fixed 
time intervals (every 2 hours or as company requires). 
7.1.9 记录事件的全过程和采取的措施。  
Record the whole process and measures taken. 
7.2 如船舶搁浅，应考虑下列危险： 
If ship is grounded, the following dangers shall be taken into consideration: 
 船舶结构可能损坏； 
Damage to the hull structure; 
 船舶可能倾覆； 
Being capsized; 
 具有危险含量的对身体有害物质可能泄漏； 
Leakage of material that contains hazardous substance in a dangerous proportion; 
 易燃物质泄漏可能引发火灾； 
Fire caused by leakage of inflammable material; 
 油舱可能受损而泄漏造成环境污染。 
Environmental pollution caused by oil spillage due to damage to the oil fuel tank. 
针对上述危险，应采取的行动： 
Following measures shall be taken under above-mentioned emergency: 
 发出遇险报警和信息，必要时使用烟火信号； 
send distress alerting and message, and use smoke signal when necessary; 
 充分注意浪涌和强流的危险，并考虑是否需要向空舱内注水，以防船舶搁浅加
剧，或船舶滑离浅滩而有可能沉没； 
Be cautious the danger from  sea, swell and strong current , decide if pump water in to the empty 
holds in order to prevent aggravating grounding, or sinking caused by slipping from the shallow 
water.  
 船体如被浪涌持续地撞击，考虑适当加注加载水，减少船体受力； 
If the ship is constantly hit by the waves, pumping into ballast water properly is suggested in 
order to reduce ship’s stressed area. 
 做好弃船准备； 
Prepare for abandon ship; 
 如公司安排拖轮救助，应尽早建立船舶与拖轮的联系； 
If company arranges tug ’s assistant   the ship shall establish contact with tugs  as soon as 
possible. 
 对液体舱、货舱和干隔舱连续测量，一旦溢油现象发生，按《舶油污应急计划》
执行； 
Conduct continuous sounding to liquid tanks, cargo holds and; once oil spillage is found, handle 
the matter according to SOPEP. 
 将情况的变化尽速报告公司。 
Report to company with any change of situation with no delay. 
7.3 损坏检验 
Damage survey 
7.3.1 保险人会派验船师来确认损坏的原因是否搁浅所致。 
Insurance company will dispatch surveyor to ascertain if the damage is due to grounding.  

43

应急计划                                   版本/修改：3.0/2.0                              CONP-05 
Contingency Plan                             Version/Revise: 3.0/2.0                            CONP -05 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                       生效日期：2020/02/14                    第16/34页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.   Effective Date: 20 20/02/14                  Page: 16/34 
7.3.2 公司将通知船舶有关船体保险人到船检查船和机械。 
Company will inform all hull underwriters to attend onboard for inspecting the ship and engine. 
7.3.3 按公司指示对登轮验船师给予协助。 
Assist the surveyor under company’s instructions. 
7.3.4 所有损坏的机械部件应保存至验船师检验结束。 
All damaged mechanical parts shall be kept till survey is finished. 
7.4 文件 
 Documents 
7.4.1 船长应准备导致搁浅的事实报告。事实报告应包括所采取的措施。 
Master shall prepare the statement report of grounding, in which the measures taken shall be 
included. 
7.4.2 应妥善保存有关的证据，如用过的海图、测深记录、车钟记录等。 
Relevant evidence shall be kept properly, such as nautical chart, sounding records， telegraph records, 
etc. 
7.4.3 记录船舶的有关花费，如加班、使用的化学药剂、设备使用、人力等。 
Record relevant expense of the ship, such as working overtime, chemicals used, equipment applied, 
labor, etc.  
7.5 破损稳性评估 
Evaluation to damage stability 
7.5.1 船舶货物、压载、淡水和燃油分布的报告。 
Distribution report of cargo, ballast, fresh water and fuel oil. 
7.5.2 安排潜水员对水下损坏情况进行探查和评估。 
Arrange divers to conduct underwater inspection and evaluation to damage.  
7.5.3 通过船舶提供的上述信息，公司将与船级社联系，获取减轻船体应力的建议。 
Company will contact the class society based on information mentioned above, in order to obtain 
suggestions regarding reducing hull’s stress. 
8.0 人员落水 
    Man overboard 
8.1 人员落水的三种情况 
Three actions of man overboard 
8.1.1 立即行动：驾驶台发现人员落水，并立即开始营救行动。 
Immediate action: launch salvation immediately when the person in wheelhouse finds man 
overboard. 
8.1.2 延迟行动： 人员落水由其他目击者报告驾驶台， 但已经过一定延迟后开始营救行动。 
Act postponed: other witness report man overboard to wheelhouse, therefore salvation begins after 
certain delay. 
8.1.3 人员失踪：发现人员失踪后报告船长，但经过较长延迟后开始营救行动。 
Man missing: report to the Master after man found missing, therefore salvation begins after longer 
delay. 
8.2 立即行动 
 Act immediately 
8.2.1 驾驶台发现人员落水后，值班驾驶员应立即： 
     While finding man overboard in wheelhouse, the officer on watch shall immediately: 
 向落水者一舷操满舵，使船尾远离落水者。 

44

应急计划                                   版本/修改：3.0/2.0                              CONP-05 
Contingency Plan                             Version/Revise: 3.0/2.0                            CONP -05 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                       生效日期：2020/02/14                    第17/34页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.   Effective Date: 20 20/02/14                  Page: 17/34 
Put the wheel ha rd over to the side where man overboard, and keep stern away from the man  
overboard. 
 向落水者抛救生圈，并使之尽量接近落水人员。 
Release man overboard lifebuoy as close as possible to the man overboard.  
 发出人落水警报。 
Raise man overboard alarm. 
 通知船长。 
Inform the Master. 
 标识船位（启动 GPS 或 ECDIS 的 MOB 键）、风向、风速和时间。 
Mark the ship ’s position ( active the MOB butto n on GPS and ECDIS), wind direction and speed, 
and time. 
 通知机舱备车。 
Inform the engine room to get engine ready. 
 使用雷达对落水人员进行跟踪标识，不使其位置丢失。 
Use radar to track the overboard man in order not to lose him. 
8.2.2 船长应指挥船舶： 
     Master shall conduct the ship to: 
 安排瞭望人员，使落水者处于视线范围以内。 
Arrange personnel to lookout the overboard man, keep him in sight.  
 投放染色标识或烟火信号。 
Release colored identifier or smoke signal.  
 安排救助队备好救助艇，以便需要时放艇。 
Arrange rescue team to prepare rescue boat, and get ready to release at any time. 
 使驾驶台、甲板和救助艇之间保持联系。 
Maintain contact among wheelhouse, main deck and rescue boat.   
 安装好引水梯准备救人。 
Rig pilot ladder for salvation. 
 尽早采用 Williamson 旋回或 Anderson 旋回操纵船舶接近并救起落水人员。 详见
《国际航空和海上搜寻救助手册》第三卷。 
Use Williamson turn or Anderson turn to maneuver to approach and save the overboard man. 
Refer to International Aeronautical and Maritime Search and Rescue Manuel, Volume III for 
more details. 
 向公司报告。 
Report to company. 
8.3 延迟行动 
  Act postponed 
8.3.1 人员落水由目击者报告驾驶台后，值班驾驶员应立即： 
After any seeing person report man overboard to the wheelhouse, the officer on watch would 
immediately: 
 发出人落水警报。 
Raise man overboard alarm. 
 标识船位（可利用 GPS 的 MOB 键）、风向、风速和时间。 
Mark ship’s position (active the MOB button of GPS and ECDIS), wind direction and speed, and 
time. 
 通知船长。

 Man missing 
8.4.1 发现有人员失踪且可能落水后应通知船长。 
Report to the Master when man is found missing and possibly fell into the water. 
8.4.2 船长得到报告后应： 
     After receiving the report, Master shall: 
 指示值班驾驶员记录得知人员失踪的时间和船位； 
Instruct the duty officer record the time and ship’s position when informed with man overboard; 
 组织全船搜查以确认失踪人员不在船上； 
Arrange search of whole ship to make sure the absence of missing person; 
 通知附近船舶、海岸电台和搜求中心； 
Broadcast to nearby ships, coast stations and Rescue Co-ordination Center (RCC); 
 搞清楚失踪人员最后在船上被看到的时间和位置；了解落水者衣着颜色等标志，
以方便搜救人员搜索辨识。 
Clarify the time and position when and where the missing person is finally seen, and color of the 
clothes or other characteristics of the overboard man, in order for the rescue person to search and 
verify. 
 决定是否应转回搜寻； 
Decide if turn around for searching; 
 如转回搜寻，应通知机舱、公司和下一港口代理。

 船长应注意， 即使人员落水已很长时间也仍有生存的可能。 因此不能轻易放弃营

Master shall be aware of the possibility of surviving despite of long time in the water, therefore 
shall not give up rescue easily. Turning around for searching is suggested as long as the ship’ s 
safety is not affected. 
8.5 营救落水人员计划和程序 
要求所有船舶应备有船舶特定的“营救落水人员的计划和程序”。 
 Plan and Procedure for Recovery of Person from Water 
 All ships are required to possess “Plan and procedure for Recovery of Person from Water”. 
8.5.1 各轮结合本船的实际情况，制定一份适合本船实际的“本船营救计划”。 
     Combining the ship’s condition, draft a practical “rescue plan for the ship”.  
8.5.2 以下附录应并与营救落水人员计划和程序一起装订成册。 
     Following appendix shall be bind in a volume with “Plan and procedure for salvaging man 
overboard”. 
附录 1《营救落水人员的计划和程序编制指南》（MSC.1/Circ.1447）；

the Water ( MSC.1/Circ.1447) 
  附录 2《营救技术指南》（MSC.1/Circ.1182） 
  Appendix 2 Guide to Recovery Technical (MSC.1/Circ.1182) 
  附录 3《寒冷水中生存指南》(MSC.1/Circ.1185/Rev.1) 
  Appendix 3 Guide for Cold Water Survival (MSC.1/Circ.1185/Rev.1) 
  附录 4 国际航空和海上搜寻救助手册（IAMSAR）第三卷 
  Appendix 4 International Aeronautical and Maritime Search and Rescue Manuel (IAMSAR), 
Volume III 
  附录 5 总布置图，救生设备布置图等资料的复本 
  Appendix 5 Copies of General Arrangement Plan, life equipment arrangement, etc. 
  附录 6 船舶操纵手册的复本 
  Appendix 6 Copies of Ship Maneuver Manual

  Appendix 7 Rescue plan for the ship 
9.0 弃船 
Abandon Ship 
在船舶的沉没、毁灭不可避免的情况下，船长可以做出弃船决定。但是，除紧急情
况外，应当报经船舶所有人同意。来不及请示时，也应将弃船行动报告船东和管理
公司，并发出遇险求救信号，请求在其附近正在航行的船舶及有关的搜寻救助机构
实施救助。 
Under the circumstances that sinking and destruction of the ship is unavoidable, the Master can declare 
abandon ship. However, except for emergency, the shipowner shall be informed first. W hen there is 
not enough time for notification, the Master shall still report the decision to shipowner and managing 
company, send distress signal, and ask for help from ships nearby and relevant RCC.   
9.1 根据以下情况，选择使用最有效的救生设备： 
Select the most effective life-saving appliance according to the following condition: 
9.1.1 当时船舶所面临的危险状况，例如火灾和船舶浸入水中的程度如何。 
The dangers faced by the ship at the moment, e.g. fire and the extent of the immersion of the ship. 
9.1.2 船体倾斜和破损程度如何。

05_10_4.text:

Extent of listing and damage of hull. 
9.1.3 气象和海况，例如风浪、气温及水温等因素。 
Weather and sea condition, e.g. waves, air and water temperature, etc.  
9.1.4 救助机关与本船通信情况以及救助船舶、 飞机与本船的相对位置和距离， 本船位置
及离岸距离。 
Communication between RCC and the ship, the relative positions and distance from rescue ship, 
airplane, and the distance from shore. 
9.1.5 各救生设备的实际工作状况。 
Working condition of all life-saving appliances. 
9.2 全体船员在奔赴集合地点前应： 
    Before rushing to the muster station, all crew shall: 
9.2.1 尽量多穿保暖性能好的衣服。 
Wear as much warm-keeping clothes as possible. 
9.2.2 尽可能多带淡水和食物。 
Take as much freshwater and food as possible. 
9.2.3 携带部署表中所规定的应携带的物品。 
Take items required in the muster list. 
9.3 固定值班人员应严守岗位 
Fixed persons on duty shall keep on watching strictly 
9.3.1 驾驶台固定值班人员仍应瞭望值守， 按船长命令操纵船舶， 执行任务； 电台负责人
及应在电台坚持通信，同时做好弃船准备工作。 
Fixed persons on duty at wheelhouse shall keep on looking out, and man euver the ship under the 
Master’s instruction and perform obligation; crew in charge of radio station shall keep 
communication at radio station, and prepare for abandon ship. 
9.3.2 机舱固定人员依然坚守操作岗位，听令操作。在得到两次“用车完毕”车令或船长
通知后，在轮机长领导下，抓紧做好熄火、关机、停电、关闭海底阀及各个油阀等
弃船安全防护工作，并携带好规定撤离机舱时应携带物品。 
Fixed persons at engine room shall keep on watching strictly, and operate under instructions. After 
receiving order of “engine finished”  two times and Master ’s notification, they shall perform 
safety-protective measures for abandon ship under Chief Engineer ’s instru ction, such as engine 
shutdown, machinery shutdown, power cutoff, and sea valves and other fuel valves closing, etc., and 
take the items required when evacuated from engine room.  
9.4 弃船时应携带的主要物品 
    Items needed when abandon ship 
9.4.1 带上当前的航海日志，船舶证书和船员文件以及船舶现金。 
Pack current log books, ship’s certificates and crew documents as well as ship’s cash.  
9.4.2 车钟记录簿（纸），本航次使用过的海图，尤其是出事地点的有关海图。 
Telegraph book (paper), charts used during the voyage, especially the chart of the accident site.  
9.4.3 望远镜和便携式双向对讲器。 
     Binocular and portable 2-way VHF. 
9.4.4 货运单证（舱单、积载图、提单副本）。 
Shipping documents (shipping bill, stowage plan, copies of bill of lading) 
9.5 到达集合地点时的行动 
    Actions at muster station 
9.5.1 全体船员，除固定值班者外，应在 2 分钟内穿好救生衣到达集合地点。

应急计划                                   版本/修改：3.0/2.0                              CONP-05

Except for fixed duty crew, all crew shall gather at muster station wearing life jacket within 2 
minutes. 
9.5.2 艇长立即清点人数，检查每人所应携带的物品。 
Coxswain takes attendance immediately, and check the items each person bring.  
9.5.3 迅速做好放艇准备工作。 
Prepare for launching lifeboat immediately. 
9.5.4 按船长发出的命令行动。 
Perform under Master’s instructions. 
9.6 当要弃船时，发出的遇险信息尽量详细： 
When abandon ship, send as much detailed distress messages as possible: 
9.6.1 船名和呼号。 
Ship’s name and call sign. 
9.6.2 船位。 
Ship’s position. 
9.6.3 需何种援助。 
Types of salvation needed. 
9.6.4 人员数量及受伤人员数量。 
Number of crew and injured crew. 
9.6.5 天气情况、风向、风力、浪、涌和能见度。 
Weather, wind direction, wind force, sea, swell, and visibility. 
9.6.6 弃船时间。 
Abandon ship time. 
9.6.7 救生艇（筏）的数量和颜色。 
Number and color of lifeboats (rafts). 
9.7 接到船长弃船命令时的行动 
 Actions taken after receiving Master’s abandonment order 
迅速登艇筏离船。船长应最后离船。 
All crew board lifeboats/rafts. Master shall leave the ship last.  
9.8 登上救生艇筏后的行动 
    Actions after boarded the lifeboat 
9.8.1 迅速离开正在下沉的船舶至少两倍船长以外。 
Rapidly leave the ship twice the length of the ship at least. 
9.8.2 寻找和集合其他遇险人员。 
Search and gather others in distress. 
9.8.3 检查救生艇筏的功能是否正常，救生筏漏气、破损及时补塞修复。 
Check if the lifeboat functions are well, and repair the lifeboat in time when leakage and damage 
detected. 
9.8.4 艇或筏应尽可能地保持相互靠拢，如可能，应用缆索系在一起。 
lifeboats/rafts shall remain close to each other, or use lines to joint together if possible. 
9.8.5 取出救生须知阅读，检查救生艇筏内部属具、设备是否齐全，熟悉其用法，以决定
待援过程中可采取的行动。 
Read life-saving instructions, check if the equipment and tools of the lifeboat are sufficient, 
familiarize with the using method, and decide measures might be adopted when waiting for the 
salvation. 
9.8.6 弃船后所有人员仍应服从船长指挥。

All crew shall still obey the Master’s orders after abandon ship. 
10.0 封闭处所人员救助 
     Rescue people from enclosed space 
10.1 发现有人员在封闭处所受困，应立即报告值班人员和船长，并同时采取措施准备    
营救。船长应启动应急程序并召集救助人员尽快到位。在救援人员到达并对现场   
情况进行评估，确保可以安全进入处所实施救援之前，任何在场船员不得进入该处
所。 
Once found person victim in enclosed space, shall report to the duty crew or Master immediately, and 
prepare for salvation. Master shall raise emergency response procedure and command the rescue team 
in position. Evaluate the on -site condition before rescue  team arrives, and make sure no one gets to 
enter the place before it is confirmed safe. 
10.2 救助队组成及进入封闭处所： 
 Composition of the rescue team and entering into enclosed space: 
10.2.1 只有训练有素和装备完善的人员可以在封闭处所内从事救援工作。救助队包括一
名在入口附近负责内外联络的队员。在满足营救任务的前提下，进入封闭处所的
救助队人员应尽量少。 
Only well-trained and well -equipped personnel can perform salvation from  enclosed spaces. The 
rescue team will be one member guarding at entrance in charge of communication between inside 
and outside. People who enter into the closed area shall be kept to minimum number on the premise 
of fulfilling rescue requirements. 
10.2.2 进入封闭处所进行营救的队员应佩带救生绳、隔绝式呼吸器、有效的照明用具和
必要的通讯设备，以及为被困人员准备的呼吸装置。 
Rescue team member enter the enclosed places shall tie  life ropes, isolated breather apparatus , 
effective lighting devices and necessary  communication devices, and breath apparatus  for victim 
personnel.  
10.2.3 船长应指挥救助队员尽快展开营救行动。开始营救的同时应尽可能地向封闭处所
内实施通风。 
Master shall command  the rescue team to rescue immediately, and also try to ventilate to the 
enclosed area at meantime. 
10.2.4 在封闭处所入口外负责协助和接应的人员应保持与进入的救助队员保持联系，并
及时报告船长。 
Personnel who guard the entrance in charge of coordination and providing support shall keep 
contact with team members that entered the site, and report to the Master in time. 
10.2.5 应尽可能控制进入封闭处所的时间，以减少救助人员的意外事故。 
Control the time inside the closed s pace, in order to reduce unexpected accidents to rescue  team 
members. 
10.2.6 在任何时候救生绳都应有专人控制，保持内外通讯畅通。 如处所中有某种障碍，
可能影响人员的行动甚至或增加危险，此时可临时解开救生绳但不能丢失，返回
前应重新接好救生绳。 
Life rope shall be controlled at all time by designated person, and communication between inside 
and outside shall remain uninterrupted. If barriers in the s pace affect team members ’ action or 
increase their risks, life rope can be loosened temporarily  but not lost, and shall be reconnected 
when members get back. 
10.3 抢救被困人员 
     Rescue victim 

50

应急计划                                   版本/修改：3.0/2.0                              CONP-05 
Contingency Plan                             Version/Revise: 3.0/2.0                            CONP -05 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                       生效日期：2020/02/14                    第23/34页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.   Effective Date: 20 20/02/14                  Page: 23/34 
10.3.1 一旦发现被困人员，应立即为其戴上呼吸器，如被困者是清醒的且能够移动，尽
快将被困者救离遇险现场。 
Once man is found the victim, one shall wear him with breather apparatus ; if the victim is 
conscious and is able to move, he shall be evacuate from site as soon as possible. 
10.3.2 如果被困人员已经昏迷但能呼吸，应立即为其戴上呼吸器进行施救，并尽快将被
困者救离遇险现场。利用呼吸器帮助呼吸时，应使被困者的脖子伸直。 
If the victim  already falls into coma but can still breathe, one shall equip him with breather and 
perform rescue, and move him out of the site as soon as possible. When using breather to help with 
breathing, the man’s neck shall remain extended. 
10.3.3 如被困者已停止呼吸，应立即将其救离遇险现场，并为其清理呼吸道，做人工呼
吸。 
If the victim stops breathing, he shall be moved out of the site as soon as possible; respiratory tract 
shall be cleaned and artificial respiration conducted.  
10.4 注意事项 
     Notes 
10.4.1 应另有一名队员佩戴独立的呼吸设备，随时作好营救准备。 
There shall be another one who wears independent breathing apparatus, and prepare for rescue at 
any time.   
10.4.2 禁止在未佩戴呼吸设备的情况下进入封闭处所，除非船长已宣布那样是安全的。 
Entering into enclosed space without breathing apparatus is prohibited, unless the Master has 
declared safety of the space. 
10.4.3 注意呼吸器气体的消耗情况。 
Pay attention to the consumption of breather. 
10.4.4 应使用带有伸缩取样管的多种气体探测仪检测封闭处所内各种气体的浓度，特别
是在被困者附近。 
Density of various gases in the enclosed space shall be tested by gas detector with stretching 
sampling pipes, especially gas around the victim. 
10.4.5 应保持对该舱室的通风，如可行，将氧气管通到施救现场。 
The space shall remain ventilated, and if situation permits, oxygen pipe can be connected to the 
rescue site. 
10.5 当存在有害气体时应特别注意： 
     One shall pay special attention when hazardous gas detected: 
10.5.1 如果人员被有害气体熏倒，大脑的正常供氧将被阻碍，并且如不在短时间内恢复
供氧，大脑将受到损伤。 
If man collapses from noxious gas, the supply of oxygen to the brain will be hampered. If oxygen 
supply cannot be restored in short time, brain will be damaged.  
10.5.2 救助队员必须在遇险者失去知觉后 4 分钟内到达现场并进行营救。 
Rescue person shall arrive at site and perform rescue within 4 minutes since the victim lost his 
consciousness. 
11.0 船员严重伤病 
Crew’s Serious Injury and Illness 
11.1 概述 
Overview 
11.1.1 当船舶发生人员严重伤病时，船长应立即组织有关人员对伤病者进行必要的抢救
和护理，应指定富有经验的专人负责护理。 

51

05_10_5.text:

When crew is injured or falls  ill seriously, the Master shall arrange relevant personnel to perform 
necessary rescue and nursing; person with rich nursing experience shall be appointed  under the 
situation. 
11.1.2 应积极使用《船舶医疗指南》和采取医疗咨询以取得必要的信息，并应遵守《急
救原则》的建议进行。 
Refer to Ship’ s Medical Guide  and search information through medical consulting, and obey the 
First Aid Principles. 
11.1.3 船长应以最快捷的方式联系代理或相关机构，请求救助。 
Master shall contact agent or relevant parties in most effective way and request for assistance. 
11.1.4 在对伤病人员进行抢救的同时，应速将其姓名、职务、发生时间、地点、伤病情
况、施救措施等报公司。 
While rescuing the sick and injured, and report to company with his/her name and position, time 
and place for illness and injury, condition, and rescue methods, etc. 
11.1.5 如船舶在航行途中发生严重伤病时， 应立即电告公司， 要求在就近港口紧急停靠，
或请公司联系岸上救助单位派有效的交通工具(如快艇等)将其接送到岸上救治。 
If serious injury or disease occurs during voyage, the ship shall report to the company immediately, 
requesting urgent berthing at nearest port, or asking company to contact shore rescue service and 
fetch the injured/sick crew by most effective transportation method (e.g. speedboat) to shore for 
treatment. 
11.2 医疗报告 
  Medical Report  
船员被送岸前，应按《船舶医疗指南》中提供的格式制作“医疗报告”并提供给岸
方。医疗报告应包括的内容包括： 
Before the crew is sent on shore, ship shall provide the medical report written in the format stipulated 
in Ship’s Medical Guide to shore. Medical report shall include: 
 船员的发病或受伤的时间。 
Time when crew fell ill or got injured. 
 发病、受伤原因及程度和病情发展。 
Reason and extent of illness and injury, and progression of condition. 
 所用药物及已采取的其他处理。 
Medicine and treatment taken. 
 使用药物和处理的效果。 
Effect after medicine and treatment. 
 必要时还应包括其病史。 
Medical history, if necessary. 
11.3 送伤病人员的准备 
  Preparations for sending injured/sick crew  
确定要送伤病船员离船时，应视情做好以下准备工作： 
Make sure follows are ready when send injured/sick crew on shore: 
 按公司指示与岸方联系，确定伤病员离船的程序。 
 Contact shore under company’s instructions, and determine the procedure for sending 
injured/sick crew on shore. 
 准备吊运设备和工具。 
Prepare hoisting appliances and tools. 
 备妥伤病船员及护送人员的证件及必要的行李。

        Prepare the documents and luggage of injured/sick crew and the escort.  
 准备好必要的伤病员离船手续。 
Prepare necessary disembark documents for the injured/sick crew. 
 做好伤病船员离船的周密计划，并及时与岸方协调。 
Make thorough disembark plan, and coordinate with shore in time. 
12.0 恶劣天气 
    Severe weather 
12.1 在恶劣天气情况下，最重要的是减小船舶所受到的应力。船长应根据船舶的特点        
和航海经验决定采取必要的行动，并考虑到以下因素： 
When encounter with severe weather, reducing ship ’s stress is the most important task. Master shall 
determine the taking measures according to ship ’s characteristics and navigation experience, as well 
as consider following factors: 
 船型； 
Type of ship; 
 装载情况； 
Stowage; 
 推进动力情况； 
Propulsion power; 
 稳性情况； 
Stability; 
 风力； 
Wind force; 
 海浪和涌的情况。 
Sea and swell 
12.2 恶劣天气来临时的准备 
Preparations for severe weather 
12.2.1 空载船舶应在稳性及强度允许的前提下，尽可能将所有压载舱压满。 
Ship in lightly loading shall fill up all ballast tanks to her best if stability and strength permit.  
12.2.2 在开敞甲板上设置安全绳，应可帮助人员在必要时从生活区行走至船首。 
Set safety rope on open deck, in order to help people walk from accommodation area to bow. 
12.2.3 选择好航线附近的备用避风锚地。 
Select the standby shelter anchorage near voyage.  
12.2.4 按照 《船舶手册》 第五章第十四节 《大风浪航行注意事项》14.1 的规定进行准备。 
Prepare according to stipulation 14.1 in Notes for Navigation in Heavy Weather, which specified in 
Section 14, Chapter 5 of Ship’s Manual. 
12.3 恶劣天气下航行的措施： 
Measures for sailing under severe weather: 
12.3.1 备车航行。 
Navigate with main engine standby. 
12.3.2 必要时根据海况适当调整航向和航速以减轻拍底、横摇、纵摇，以及对推进装置
和船体的应力。 
Properly adjust course and speed according to sea condition, in order to reduce ship’s pounding, 
rolling, and pitching, as well as the stress to propulsion appliance and hull. 
12.3.3 注意观察船舶航行状况， 如果横摇/纵摇剧烈， 可采用在计划航向附近改变航向以
减轻摇摆，避免造成船体受损或货物移动。继续航行困难时可采取滞航措施。

应急计划                                   版本/修改：3.0/2.0                              CONP-05

Observe the ship’s navigation. In case of heavy rolling/pitching, ship can change course near 
planned course in order to reduce rolling/pitching, which might cause damage to the hull or cargo 
movement. Heave to be suggested when navigation is difficult in progression. 
12.3.4 没有船长的许可，任何人不得到露天甲板。如必须在生活区外进行工作，应严格
按照《船舶手册》中第五章第十四节《大风浪航行注意事项》14.4 的规定采取必
要的防护措施。 
No one shall go to the weather deck without Master’s permission. If necessarily work outside 
accommodation area is, one shall take necessary protective measures stipulated in 14.4 of Notes for 
Navigation in Heavy Weather, which specified in Section 14, Chapter 5 of Ship’s Manual. 
12.3.5 密切关注天气预报，尤其是台风等灾害性天气系统的动向，采取必要措施规避危
险。 
Pay close attention to weather forecast, especially the moving trend of disastrous weather situation 
such as typhoon, and take necessary measures to avoid danger. 
12.3.6 当船舶在恶劣天气情况下发生操纵困难时，应立即与公司联系。 
Contact the company when ship encounters maneuver difficulty in severe weather. 
12.4 恶劣天气过后的措施 
Measures after severe weather 
 检查船体、船舶设备受损情况。 
Check damage condition to the hull and equipments. 
 测量各货舱，各油、水舱，确定有否受损。 
Judge if any damage by sound cargo holds, oil tanks, and water tanks. 
 检查货物受损情况。 
Check the damage condition of cargo. 
 修复损坏设备，采取措施减少货物损失。 
Repair damaged equipment, and take measures to reduce cargo loss. 
 把情况书面报告公司。 
Send written report to company. 
13.0 货物移动 
     Cargo Shift 
13.1 立即采取的行动 
     Measures taken immediately 
13.1.1 如果发现货物发生移动，或者怀疑舱内货物发生移动，发现者应立即通知驾驶台
或报告船长。 
One shall inform the wheelhouse or Master immediately when find shifting of cargo . is found or 
suspected. 
13.1.2 货舱内有异常响动、船舶横倾发生变化、船体发生异常震动等现象，都可能是发
生了货物移动。 
Abnormal sound in holds, the list vary, and hull abnormal shakes might all due to cargo shifting.  
13.1.3 船长应立即上驾驶台指挥，并安排大副、水手长等人员检查装货处所。 
Master shall reach to wheelhouse immediately for instruction, and arrange Chief Officer and 
Boatswain to check cargo areas. 
13.1.4 如果船舶在大风浪中航行，检查人员应按照《船舶手册》中第五章第十四节《大
风浪航行注意事项》14.4 的规定执行。

应急计划                                   版本/修改：3.0/2.0                              CONP-05

If navigation in heavy weather, personnel who inspect shall perform according to 14.4 stipulated in 
Notes for Navigation in H eavy Weather, which specified in Section 14, Chapter 5 of Ship’ s 
Manual. 
13.1.5 如果条件许可，船舶应立即调整航向、航速以减少船舶摇摆。 
If situation permits, the ship shall adjust her course and reduce speed immediately in order to 
reduce rolling and pitching. 
13.1.6 大副、水手长和水手检查货物移动情况并向船长报告： 
Chief Officer, Boatswain and sailors shall check cargo shifting condition, and report to Master: 
 发生移动的货物种类和大约数量 
Types and quantity of the shifting cargo. 
 货物移动后的位置，移动的方向和大约距离； 
Location where the cargo shift to, shifting direction and distance; 
 移动的原因（如已得知）； 
Reason for shift (if acquired); 
 货物和船舶的损坏情况（如有）； 
Damage to cargo and ship (if any); 
 进一步移动或损坏的可能性； 
Possibility of further shift and damage; 
 建议的措施。 
Advisable measures. 
13.1.7 轮机长到机舱指挥，保证甲板所需要的支持，保证压载泵随时可用、甲板设备所
需的动力供应等。 
Chief Engineer conduct at the engine room, make sure the deck gets support needed, and ensure the 
ballast pump is running at any time, and sufficient power supply for the deck equipments. 
13.1.8 应考虑减小油、水舱室自由液面的影响。 
Affect brought by reducing free surface of oil and water tanks shall be taken into consideration. 
13.1.9 尽快报告公司。 
Report to the company as soon as possible. 
13.2 后续行动 
     Follow up actions  
13.2.1 船长应判定重新加固货物的风险和可行性，并与大副和水手长等现场检查人员商
议加固方案。 
Master shall determine the risks and feasibility of re-lashing cargo, and discuss lashing method with 
Chief Officer, Boatswain and surveyors on-site.  
13.2.2 重新加固货物的方案应由船长批准，并报告公司。 
Re-lashing cargo plan shall be approved by the Master and reported to the company. 
13.2.3 在保证人员安全的前提下，大副应按照船长批准的方案组织甲板部人员尽快重新
加固货物，必要时向船长申请安排其他部门船员参加。 
On premise of crew ’s safety, the Chief Officer shall arrange crew of deck department re- lash the 
cargo according to lashing method approved by the Master, and can request the Master to let crew 
from other department join in the operation when necessary. 
13.2.4 根据对大副移动货物重量和船舶稳性的计算，船长应评估是否可安全地利用调整
压载水来纠正横倾。如可行，则应尽快实施以防止进一步的货物移动。

According to calculation of shifting cargo weight and ship’ s stability by Chief officer, the Master 
shall evaluate if it is safe to correct listing by adjusting the ballast water. If it is feasible, the ship 
shall implement the measure to prevent further cargo shift. 
13.2.5 重新加固货物后，船长应重新评估船舶的稳性和航行性能，以及可能遇到的不利
天气和海况，决定船舶是否可以续航。 
After re-lashing the cargo, Master shall re -evaluate the ship ’s stability and seaworthiness, and the 
possible bad weather and sea condition, determine whether the ship shall continue her sailing. 
13.2.6 船长应向公司报告货物重新加固的过程和效果。如有必要，船长应请示公司将船
舶转至某港口对移动货物进一步加固。 
Master shall report to the company with process and effect of cargo re -lashing. Also the Master 
shall request to the company for approaching a port and conduct further lashing the shifted cargo.  
14.0 船体结构损坏 
Ship’s Structural Damage  
船体结构损坏可能由下列原因引起： 
Damage to the ship structure might due to the following reasons: 
 碰撞 
Collision 
 搁浅 
Grounding 
 货物的不当装卸 
Improper loading/discharging of cargo 
 冰区航行 
Navigation in ice 
 大风浪航行 
Navigation in heavy weather 
 船体结构自身缺陷 
Defects of ship structure 
14.1  发现损坏情况后的检查和评估 
  Inspection and evaluation after damage detected 
14.1.1 尽早发现损坏情况非常重要。因此船舶必须坚持按规定定期检查船体结构。 
It is very important to find the damage as early as possible, therefore hull structure should be kept 
inspection in a fixed interval according to regulations. 
14.1.2 发现船体结构损坏时，发现者应立即报告船长。 
When found structural damaged to the ship, one shall report to the Master immediately. 
14.1.3 船长应尽快安排人员对损坏部位进行检查，确定损坏位置和损坏程度。 
Master shall arrange personnel to inspect damaged part as soon as possible, and determine the 
damage location and extent.  
14.1.4 损坏部位的邻近区域也应进行检查，如可能，应对液体舱、货舱、干隔舱和其他
舱室（居住间、库房和机舱等）进行目视检查。 
Other areas near the damaged location shall be inspected too, and visual inspection shall be carried 
out to liquid tanks, cargo holds, voids, and other compartments (accommodation, stores, and engine 
room, etc.) if possible.  
14.1.5 船长应安排立即对所有的液体舱、货舱污水和干隔舱进行测量，以确定可能的渗
漏。
