05_10_6.chapter: 第五章 船舶应急反应指南
05_10_6.text:
应急计划                                   版本/修改：3.0/2.0                              CONP-05 
Contingency Plan                             Version/Revise: 3.0/2.0                            CONP -05 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                       生效日期：2020/02/14                    第29/34页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.   Effective Date: 20 20/02/14                  Page: 29/34 
Master shall arrange sound all liquid tanks, bilges in cargo holds, and voids immediately, in order 
to ascertain possible leakage. 
14.1.6 船长应尽快将已确认的船体结构损坏情况报告公司。 
Master shall report to company with the confirmed hull structure damage as soon as possible. 
14.1.7 对于损坏部位进行下列几方面的检查和评估： 
Following inspection and evaluation shall be conducted to damaged parts: 
 破损的位置、程度和进一步发展的趋势； 
The location, extend and development tendency of the damage; 
 从破损部位向船体内部进水的速度和对船舶浮性的影响； 
Flooding ratio from damaged area and affect on ship’s buoyancy;  
 进水对船舶设备和货物的威胁； 
Threats to equipments and cargo onboard from flooding; 
 货舱和液体舱室之间的泄漏； 
Leakage between cargo holds and liquid tanks; 
 造成污染的可能性及危害程度； 
Possibility of causing pollution and its damage extent; 
 船舶自行解决的可能性及所需的支持。 
Possibility of ship’s self-settlement and support needed. 
14.2  控制损坏的行动 
Actions for controlling damage  
14.2.1 一般损坏（局部裂缝或渗漏等） 
General damage (local cracks or leakage) 
 控制损坏的延伸，如：在裂缝的末端打止裂孔； 
Control the spreading of damage, e.g. drill stop hole at the end of crack; 
 采取临时或永久性修理，以减轻结构损坏和其他损失； 
Take temporary or permanent repair, in order to reduce structure damage or other loss; 
 船长应确定适航能力是否受到影响； 
Master shall confirm if the ship’s seaworthiness is affected; 
 如船体已进水，可通过改变吃水差控制进水或使用水泵排水，保证船舶浮性； 
If ship is flooding, controlling water by changing trim or draining water by using pumps are 
advisable, in order to keep ship’s buoyancy; 
 降低船速，以减小船体受力；进而减轻受损部位的应力； 
Slow down ship’s speed to reduce stress; and further reduce stress to the damaged area;  
 申请公司安排就近港口修理； 
Request the company to arrange repair at nearby ports; 
 记录事件经过和采取的措施，拍摄损坏照片以备理赔使用； 
Record the process and measures taken, and take damage photos for claim; 
 报告公司损坏的程度和已采取的措施。 
Report to the company with damage extent and measures taken. 
14.2.2 较大损坏 
Serious damage 
 较大的船舶结构损坏会对船舶安全带来重大威胁，一旦发现，船长应立即发出
应急警报，组织人员尽快查明损坏部位和程度，评估损坏对船舶浮性和稳性的
危害，决定应急措施。 

57

应急计划                                   版本/修改：3.0/2.0                              CONP-05 
Contingency Plan                             Version/Revise: 3.0/2.0                            CONP -05 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                       生效日期：2020/02/14                    第30/34页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.   Effective Date: 20 20/02/14                  Page: 30/34 
The serious structural damage to the ship that is a major threatens to the ship’s safety. Once 
found, the Master shall raise alarm immediately, and arrange personnel to verify the damage 
location and extent, evaluate harm to ship’s buoyancy and stability, and decide on emergency 
measures. 
 向报告公司损坏情况、可能的发展趋势和船舶准备采取的措施。 
Report to the company with the damage condition, possible development trend, and the taken 
measures. 
 船舶应发挥船舶最大排水能力排出破损舱室进水或本船的压载水，保持船舶应
有的浮力，保持船舶正浮，减轻船舶结构应力以防止破损扩大。 
Ship shall perform the maximum ability to drain flooding water from the damaged holds or 
ship’s ballast water, in order to keep ship’s buoyancy and remain upright, and reduce the stress 
to ship’s structure in preventing further enlargement of the damage. 
 关闭相关管系阻止进水扩散。 
Shut down relevant pipes in preventing spreading of flood. 
 采取可行的堵漏措施控制进水速度。 
Take proper leakage stoppage measures to control flooding rate. 
 停船或降低航速，并调整航向使受损部位处于下风，以减小进水速度。 
Stop engine or slow down, and adjust course in order to put damaged area at lee side for 
reducing flooding rate. 
 船长应熟悉 IMO 通函 MSC/Circ.1143《散货船船体破损及弃船必要的早期评估
指南》。当散货船发生较大船体结构损坏时，船长应考虑该通函的指导意见并
采取相应行动。 
Master shall be familiar with IMO circulars MSC/Circ.1143Guidelines on Early Assessment 
of Hull Damage and Possible Need for Abandonment of Bulk Carriers. When bulk carrier 
encounters with major damage to ship structure, Master shall refer to the guidance specified in 
IMO MSC circular and take corresponding measures. 
14.3  后续行动 
  Follow up actions 
14.3.1 将船舶的重力分布报公司，以便公司联系船级社进行破舱稳性计算。 
Report to the company with ship’s gravity distribution, in order for company to contact the class 
society for calculating the damaged stability. 
14.3.2 按照船级社提出的建议，采取措施以减小船舶应力，使船舶安全抵达修理港口。 
Based on suggestions provided by class society, take measures to reduce stress to the ship in order 
for the ship arrives at repair port safely. 
14.3.3 记录事件经过和采取的措施，对损坏的情况拍照或制作示意图。 
Record the progress and measures of the matter, and take photos to damaged areas or draw a 
diagram. 
14.3.4 按公司要求的时间间隔期向公司报告船舶后续情况，直到船舶抵达安全港口进行
修理。 
Report to company with following up information at intervals required by company, until the ship 
arrives at port for repair safely. 
15.0 救助 
     Salvation 
15.1 总则 
General principles

应急计划                                   版本/修改：3.0/2.0                              CONP-05 
Contingency Plan                             Version/Revise: 3.0/2.0                            CONP -05 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                       生效日期：2020/02/14                    第31/34页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.   Effective Date: 20 20/02/14                  Page: 31/34 
15.1.1 当船舶由于自身或外部原因而使船上人员、财产面临危险，且船长认为需要外界
紧急援助时，船长有权请求相关机构或船舶提供救助。 
When crew or property onboard is facing with danger due to ship’ s inner or external reasons, and 
Master considers it necessary for outside assistance, the Master is authorized to ask relevant 
organizations or ships to provide rescue. 
15.1.2 如时间允许，船长应尽可能向公司报告，以便公司采取适当的措施。 
If time permits, the Master shall report to company in time, in order for the company to take proper 
measures. 
15.1.3 如果船员和船舶没有面临紧迫危险，船长的求救应请示公司批准，并在公司指导
下与救助方进行相关的谈判。 
If crew and ship are not faced with  imminent danger, Master’s rescue call shall be permitted by 
company first, and shall negotiate with the rescue service under the company’s instructions. 
15.2 立即采取的行动 
     Actions taken immediately 
15.2.1 在紧迫危险情况下，船长应立即发布求救信息，请求救助，且应尽快告知公司。 
Under imminent danger, Master shall send distress signal immediately and request for assistance, 
and report to the company as soon as possible. 
15.2.2 测定船位并记录求救时间。 
Fix the ship’s position and record time for distress call. 
15.2.3 将求救行动记入船舶日志。 
Record the rescue actions into logbook. 
15.2.4 指定专人负责保持与救助方、救助指挥协调机构和公司的联系，记录与各方通讯
联系内容。 
Nominate designated personnel to keep contact between rescue parties, RCC, and company, and 
record communication content among all relevant parties. 
15.2.5 以营救人命为首要原则，做好接受救助的准备工作，与救助方配合，争取最佳效
果。 
Making saving lives as priority, prepare for the salvation, cooperate with rescue parties and aim at 
best result.   
15.2.6 记录所有救助方采取的施救行动和实际效果，有条件时进行录音和拍照。 
Record all rescue measures and results of the rescue parties, and conduct recording and take photos 
if condition permits. 
15.2.7 救助结束后清点损失情况，将救助过程和最终结果报告公司。 
Check loss after salvation, and report the company with rescue process and results. 
15.2.8 注意： 
Notes: 
 多数救助方倾向于使用劳氏救助合同标准格式， 即： 无效果无报酬救助合同 （见
本计划附录 1），也称作 LOF； 
Most salvage parties intend to use Lloyd’ s Standard Fo rm of Salvage Agreement, which is 
stipulated as no cure no pay contract (See Appendix 1), and is also referred as LOF; 
 只有在下列情况下才宜使用上述救助合同： 
Above-mentioned contract can only be used under following situations: 
 没有更多的时间来讨论合同问题； 
There is not enough time for discussing the contract; 
 船舶或船员面临危险。

After signing on the LOF, salvage party is authorized to claim reward based on saved property. 
However if no imminent danger is involved and that time permits, the company shall sign a 
salvage contract with the salvage party, instead of LOF. 
15.3 文件 
     Document 
15.3.1 船长应保存好下列情况的记录： 
Master shall keep the following records： 
 被救助的人员、船舶和财产； 
Saved crew, ship and property; 
 救助方在防止/减小财产损失和环境破坏方面表现出的技能和努力； 
Expertise and efforts shown during operation to reduce property loss and avoid environmental  
pollution; 
 救助方的施救工作：所花费的时间和损失；所使用的船舶和其他准备使用于施
救的设备；施救设备的情况及缺陷。 
Rescue operation by salvage party: time spent and loss; used ships and other prepared rescue 
equipment; condition and defect of rescue equipment. 
15.3.2 船长应注意记录并保存好航海日志中有关天气和海况情况，以及本船船员为减小
船舶和货物的危险所采取的措施。这对确定救助费用非常重要。 
Master shall record the weather and sea condition into logbook and keep them, as well as the 
measures taken by ship’s crew to reduce cargo loss and eliminate ship’s danger. It is very important 
to ascertain the salvage charge. 
16.0 网络攻击 
Cyber Attacks 
16.1. 当发现船舶计算机有黑客攻击或者中毒后， 应立即将该电脑从网络上隔离出来， 拔
掉网线。 
Isolate the computer from the network and unplugged immediately when it is found that the ship's 
computer was attacked or poisoned by hackers. 
16.2. 立即对内部网内所有电脑采取防范措施，断开网络。 
Take precautions against all computers in the Intranet and disconnect the network immediately. 
16.3. 船长立即通知公司 IT 主管，对攻击或中毒情况进行反馈。 
The captain immediately informed the IT supervisor of the company to give feedback on the attack or 
poisoning. 
16.4. 检查中毒电脑，判断数据损失情况，IT 主管会根据实际情况指导船舶对损失的数
据和资料立即采取相应的措施。 
Check the damaged computer and judge the loss of data, IT supervisor will guide the ship to take 
corresponding measures for the loss of data according to the actual situation. 
16.5. 如邮件电脑被攻击， 启用已配备的备用电脑， 但必须与内部网隔离， 将前期备份的
数据拷贝到此台电脑，直接接到网络上进行邮件收发。 
If the computer for mail operation is attacked, the backup computer which have been equipped on 
board should be used, but it must be isolated from the Intranet, and copy the early backup data to this 
computer, directly connected to the cyber to send and receive mail.

17.0  保安威胁 
Security Threats 
船舶遭遇到保安威胁时，船舶应参照《船舶保安计划》中的要求采取行动，同时尽
快向公司报告。

对船舶溢油的应急处置，应执行经主管机关认可的机构批准的《船上油污应急计
划》。 
 For emergency measures under oil spillage, shall refer to SOPEP that is approved by organizations 
authorized by administration in charge.

对船舶应急拖带处置，应执行船上《应急拖带程序手册》。 
 For ship’s emergency towage, shall refer to Emergency Towing Procedure Manual.

Search & Rescue

20.2 对所有遇险的频率保持持续的守听。  
Maintain continuous listening watch on all distress frequencies. 
20.3 转发遇险信息直到收到来自岸台的确认  
Relay the distress message if no acknowledgement received from shore station. 
20.4 参考IAMSAR III手册  
Consult IAMSAR III manual. 
20.5 以最快安全的速度前往遇险地点并通知救援。  
Proceed at maximum safe speed to distress location and inform Rescue. 
20.6 协调搜救协调中心(RCC)，通知船东/租家/相关利益方  
Coordination Centre (RCC). Inform owners/ charterers/ interested parties of deviation. 
20.7 建立与所有其他地面单位和SAR航空器的通信.  
Establish communications with all other surface units and SAR aircraft involved in the SAR 
operation.   
20.8 标绘其他搜救单位的位置、航向和航速。  
Plot position, courses and speeds of other assisting units

第六章 应急训练和演习 
Chapter 6  Emergency Exercise and Drills 
 
1.0  船舶应急训练和演习 
Ship’s emergency exercise and drills 
1.1 船长按本章规定的“船舶年度应急训练和演习计划” （见本计划附录 2）组织船舶应
急训练和演习。 
    Master shall carry out emergency exercise and drills according to “Ship Annual Plan for Emergency 
Drill and Exercise”. 
1.2 船长应事先设定假想的紧急情况，并在演习开始时向全船宣布。 
    Master shall design a hypothetical emergency, and declare to the crew while drill begins. 
1.3 船长应确保演习的环境是安全的，应符合强制性法规的要求和所在港口当局的规定，
同时不应造成他船或岸上人员的误会。 
    Master shall make sure that the environment is safe for drill, and conform to requirements of mandatory 
law and port authority rules, and shall not cause misunderstanding to other ships or shore-based staff.  
1.4 在保证船舶安全的前题下，演习应尽量涵盖本手册第五章《船舶应急反应指南》的相
关内容。演习的过程应符合要求并达到船长的满意，否则船长应宣布演习失败并重新
开始演习。 
    On premise of guarant eeing the ship’s safety, drill shall cover relevant content specified in <Ship’ s 
Emergency Response Guideline > (Chapter 5). The process  shall meet the requirement and Master ’s 
satisfaction, or the Master shall declare failing drill and restart.  
1.5 弃船、消防和救助艇演习应符合 SOLAS 公约第 3 章第 19 条的规定，应急操舵训练应
符合 SOLAS 公约第 5 章第 26 条的要求。 
    Abandonment, fire, rescue dills shall be with requirement of  article 19, Chapter 3 in SOLAS, and 
emergency steering drill shall meet requirements of article 26, Chapter 5 SOLAS. 
1.6 演习结束后，至少对以下各项进行评估：  
    After drills, evaluations shall be carried out to at least following items: 
 船舶应变系统、设备和器材的随时可用情况； 
Whether the emergency system, equipment and apparatus are available at any time; 
 指挥人员的控制、调度能力； 
Commander’s controlling and managing ability; 
 船员熟悉本人应变职责的情况； 
Whether crews familiarize with their own response responsibilities; 
 船员对应变知识、方法的掌握情况； 
Whether crews understand emergency knowledge and methods;

2.0 船岸联合演习 
     Ship Shorebase Joint Drills  
2.1 演习计划 
    Exercise Plan 
2.1.1 海务部负责制定“船岸联合应急演习年度计划”，报请经指定人员批准后执行。

The ship-shore base joint drill shall be carried out according  to “Annual Plan For Ship- Shore Joint 
Emergency Drill”, and all emergency situations shall be covered in all items within every 5 calendar 
years. 
2.1.3 海务部应根据上述计划，督促主管部门制定“船岸联合演习方案”、“船岸联合演习
计划”,该方案和计划应提前通知相应的船舶、公司最高管理层和指定人员。 
According to above-mentioned plan, the Marine Department shall supervise the department in charge to 
make “Ship-Shore base Joint Drill Proposal”and “Ship-Shore base Joint Drill Plan”, which shall be 
informed to relevant ships, top management of company, and designated personnel in advance. 
2.1.4 船舶应确认“方案”中约定的训练和演习项目。 
Ship shall confirm the arranged exercise and drill items in the “Plan”.

演习记录完成后由海务部统一保存。

emergency response responsibilities, and attach all relevant co mmunication draft and notes. All

2.2.5 船舶做好“船舶应急训练和演习记录”。

2.3 船岸联合演习的总结和评估。

2.3.3 船舶应进行船岸联合训练和演习总结和评估。

2.4 船岸演习结束后，主管部门应将本次演习的相关资料分发各船舶。
